National Wrestling Alliance star Bryan Idol replied with a suggestive one-word question about buns, prompting an equally flirty and direct response from St. Claire. The playful public exchange quickly escalated as St. Claire made it clear she was specifically targeting Idol's backside in her comments.

stories.title: Vince Russo Addresses JCW Exit Speculation
stories.tldr: Vince Russo has addressed ongoing speculation regarding his status with Juggalo Championship Wrestling, explaining that he currently finds himself in limbo regarding his future with the promotion. While he has previously cited personal reasons like COVID concerns and his wife's recent retirement for missing certain appearances, Russo noted that his initial show-by-show agreement has reached the one-year mark, prompting a natural period of reevaluation. He emphasized to fans that there is no backstage drama or falling out, and directed those seeking full details to his personal subscription platform for an in-depth explanation.

stories.title: Analysis of WWE Buying AAA and Its Effect on CMLL Interest
stories.tldr: Following WWE's acquisition of Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide in April 2025, search interest in the promotion skyrocketed in Mexico and grew significantly in the United States. Google Trends data shows that while AAA experienced a massive surge in brand awareness and baseline interest driven by WWE marketing and stars like Rey Mysterio, rival promotion CMLL also saw a steady, gradual increase in popularity. This phenomenon suggests a rising tide lifts all ships in the Mexican lucha libre market, potentially as casual interest expands or as traditional fans seek out CMLL as an alternative to corporate ownership.

stories.title: Top Pro Wrestling Matches on September 18 in History
stories.tldr: September 18 holds a rich history of incredible professional wrestling matches spanning promotions across the globe. According to Cagematch ratings and Wrestling Observer Newsletter star ratings, bouts from NJPW, Dragongate, WWE, CMLL, and more highlight this date. Topping the list is the legendary 2021 G1 Climax encounter between Shingo Takagi and Tomohiro Ishii, which earned a staggering five and a half star rating from Dave Meltzer.

stories.title: Historical Title Changes on September 18th
stories.tldr: September eighteenth marks a relatively slower day for professional wrestling title changes with approximately two hundred seventy notable historical changes recorded on this date. Major historical highlights include Steve Austin capturing the WCW United States Heavyweight Title in 1994, Ric Flair winning the WWE Intercontinental Title in 2005, and John Cena claiming the WWE Title in 2011. The date also features numerous championship changes across promotions like WCW, WWE, ECW, CMLL, TNA, ROH, and AJPW spanning from 1981 through 2023.

stories.title: Shota Umino Discusses Concussion Recovery and IWGP Global Title Status
stories.tldr: NJPW star Shota Umino has opened up about his severe concussion recovery after being pulled from the G1 Climax earlier this year, detailing struggles with amnesia and daily tasks during his two weeks as a shut-in. Following proper medical protocols and a gradual return to training, Umino successfully made his return during the Destruction tour. He also addressed the IWGP Global Championship picture, noting that memory loss caused by his concussion makes him eager to get closure and challenge the winner of the upcoming title matches.

stories.title: CMLL 93rd Anniversary Event and Results
stories.tldr: Jeff Jarrett officially completed his high-profile CMLL debut by submitting to Blue Panther at the promotion's anniversary event. In the marquee main event, Místico defeated Averno in a Mask vs. Hair match to keep his undefeated Apuestas record intact. The historic Arena Mexico card also featured a stacked lineup of international stars from AEW, NJPW, and Stardom.

stories.title: MLW Tubi Deal and Tessa Blanchard Situation
stories.tldr: Major League Wrestling has secured a rights fee and library revenue-share agreement for its new Tubi streaming deal, which was finalized back in August. Meanwhile, backstage details reveal that the fallout over Tessa Blanchard's aborted MLW debut is more complicated than initially thought. Reports indicate CMLL representatives were actually on the call during Blanchard's TMZ announcement, contradicting the promotion's public stance of being completely caught off guard.

stories.title: Indie Wrestler Ganon Jones Jr. Steps Away Following Andy Williams' Passing
stories.tldr: Independent wrestler Ganon Jones Jr., who competed against Andy Williams in his final match, has announced he is stepping away from the ring. Jones made the decision after his young daughter witnessed the tragic event and texted him asking him to stop wrestling out of fear he might not return home. While he hopes to eventually return, Jones stated that he needs to prioritize being a father right now.

stories.title: Walker Stewart Clarifies Contract Details With NJPW and AEW
stories.tldr: Walker Stewart has revealed the exact lengths and terms of his new agreements across the wrestling industry. His full-time NJPW contract runs through January 2029, while his full-time STARDOM deal extends to June 2027. Additionally, he will make per-appearance AEW appearances one to twice a month, and STARDOM has brought in Jimbo Bonji to share commentary duties with him.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling NOAH N-1 Victory Tournament Updates
stories.tldr: As Pro Wrestling NOAH continues its N-1 Victory tour following recent roster setbacks, the B Block standings are taking shape with Masa Kitamiya pulling ahead as the sole undefeated wrestler. Kitamiya defeated Manabu Soya in Hiroshima to claim six points, while OZAWA handed veteran KENTA his third consecutive loss. Meanwhile, Titus Alexander picked up a victory over Kai Koga and immediately issued a warning to OZAWA ahead of their upcoming clash.

stories.title: Dexter Lumis, Joseph Sawyer, and Erick Redbeard Team at BRCW
stories.tldr: Former WWE stars Erick Redbeard, Sam Shaw, and Joseph Sawyer are officially reuniting to challenge for the BRCW Six-Man Tag Team Championship. The trio will face reigning champions Gangrel and The Righteous at the upcoming Cruisin For A Bruisin 4 event. The high-stakes title match is officially scheduled for November 6, 2026, at the Miami Airport Convention Center in Florida.

stories.title: Paige Collett's Contract Status With NWA Revealed
stories.tldr: Despite frequent appearances alongside Sirena Veil and heavy involvement in recent storylines, Paige Collett is not currently under contract with the National Wrestling Alliance. Speculation regarding her official status grew following other recent roster signings, but sources confirm no paperwork has been finalized. The door remains wide open for a potential full-time deal in the future as fans continue to take notice of her television impact.

stories.title: TNA iMPACT Updates and Bound for Glory Match Additions
stories.tldr: Rich Swann has secured the fourth spot in the upcoming Bound For Glory six-way match for the vacant X-Division Championship after defeating LJ Cleary. Meanwhile, next week's September 24 episode of iMPACT will feature Mustafa Ali defending the TNA International Championship against Jason Hotch and Trey Miguel, alongside a four-way Knockouts TV title eliminator. Additionally, singles action between Eddie Edwards and Elijah has been booked following recent tag team fallout involving The System.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett Set for Semi-Regular Runs in CMLL
stories.tldr: AEW veteran Jeff Jarrett is scheduled to make his CMLL in-ring debut against Blue Panther at the promotion's upcoming anniversary show at Arena Mexico. Although initially billed as a one-night attraction, reports indicate that Jarrett is very interested in turning the appearance into a longer, semi-regular arrangement while remaining under contract with AEW. He hopes to work programs and build toward bigger matches similar to Johnny TV's recent stint, though on a larger scale. While Jarrett has extensive prior history in Mexican lucha libre with AAA, whether this expanded CMLL run will ultimately materialize remains to be seen.

stories.title: Motor City Machine Guns Missing from AEW Television
stories.tldr: The Motor City Machine Guns have experienced a stop-and-start run in AEW since officially joining the promotion, leading to fan questions about their absence. According to a recent report, their sporadic television appearances are not due to creative issues, but rather because they chose to honor prior tour commitments and projects, including their rock band Grpplng. Although AEW debuted them in Detroit against their initial preference, the veteran duo is expected to have plenty of opportunities in the tag team division once their outside schedule clears.

stories.title: Jim Ross Praises Tony Khan's Recent AEW Booking
stories.tldr: Veteran wrestling broadcaster Jim Ross recently offered high praise for AEW President Tony Khan, highlighting the company's emotional and well-received tribute shows for Rebel and the late Andy Williams, known as The Butcher. Speaking on his podcast, Ross commended Khan for successfully managing these sensitive productions as a solo booker without a committee. Furthermore, Ross noted that he has been genuinely impressed by AEW's recent show formatting and ongoing roster development.

stories.title: AEW Announcer Addresses Speculation Over Bayley
stories.tldr: Bayley's current contract status with WWE remains a subject of intense speculation despite her recent television return and renewed feud with Lyra Valkyria. While conflicting reports circulate regarding whether she has re-signed, fans and analysts continue to wonder if she might eventually follow her best friend Mercedes Mone to AEW. Addressing these rumors on a recent podcast, veteran announcer Jim Ross enthusiastically endorsed the idea of Bayley joining the roster. Ross emphasized that her leadership and in-ring talent would be a tremendous asset to the growing women's division.

stories.title: Jim Ross Gives Health Update After Dermatologist Visit
stories.tldr: Wrestling legend Jim Ross provided a health update on his latest podcast episode following a stressful dermatologist appointment where multiple biopsies were taken from his back. Ross is currently dealing with several ongoing health challenges, including recovering from August brain surgery, broken toes, and a persistent ankle wound stemming from 2021 skin cancer radiation treatments. Despite these hardships, he recently received positive news regarding a non-cancerous kidney mass and remains determined to heal and return to AEW pay-per-view commentary.

stories.title: Jim Ross and Matt Hardy Pay Tribute to Andy 'The Butcher' Williams
stories.tldr: Tributes continue to pour in for the late Andy The Butcher Williams following his tragic passing at age 48. AEW commentator Jim Ross recently shared fond memories of Williams on his podcast, praising his positive attitude and the value he brought to the tag team division. Additionally, TNA star Matt Hardy reflected on his time working with Williams, highlighting his genuine nature and deep appreciation for the wrestling business.

stories.title: Jack Perry's Quest for the AEW World Championship
stories.tldr: Jack Perry is actively pursuing the AEW World Championship by challenging the company's former title holders one by one. Despite suffering early singles losses to Jon Moxley and Swerve Strickland, Perry claims he embraces the defeats as valuable learning experiences. He has now set his sights on other former champions like Samoa Joe, while names like CM Punk are entirely off the table.

stories.title: Big Vinny V Discusses Nick Wayne's Momentum in AEW
stories.tldr: Following his recent loss and violent outburst over his damaged heirloom on Dynamite, analysts are pointing out Nick Wayne's severe lack of momentum on AEW's flagship show. Wayne has not won a match on Dynamite since March 2025 and holds a dismal pay-per-view record. Observers argue that booking Wayne for a standard TV win immediately would help rebuild his credibility ahead of his ongoing program with Chris Jericho.

stories.title: Jim Cornette Shares Doubts on Steven Borden's Wrestling Future
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Jim Cornette recently evaluated Steven Borden following his official AEW in-ring debut alongside Darby Allin. While Cornette praised Steven's impressive physique, athleticism, and pedigree, he expressed serious doubts about his long-term wrestling future. The outspoken manager pointed out that starting a career at age 34 and receiving training from Darby Allin present major hurdles for the rising star.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland Theme Song Approval Before AEW All In
stories.tldr: Swerve Strickland recently revealed that the licensing rights for The New Level's entrance music at AEW All In were secured just 24 hours before the event. Speaking on Hot 97, Strickland explained that A$AP Ferg's team gave the final approval for the 2015 hit track right down to the wire. He noted that the dramatic timing created a perfect storm that successfully hyped the Wembley Stadium crowd. Strickland also believes the iconic track provides a refreshing career reset for himself, Austin Creed, and Kofi.

stories.title: Bryan Alvarez AEW Dynamite Episode Report
stories.tldr: Subscribers can now access the complete audio breakdown of the September 16 episode of AEW Dynamite. The latest review covers the show's build toward All Out alongside its mixed reception. Listeners can dive into the detailed analysis regarding the matches, performances, and controversial booking decisions from the broadcast.

stories.title: Perry Saturn Recalls Shooting Incident, Backstage Stories, and Struggles
stories.tldr: Former professional wrestler Perry Saturn opened up about his turbulent career, severe drug battles, and harrowing personal history in a recent candid interview. He detailed a 2004 shooting where he was shot in the neck while trying to stop an attack, a tragedy that led to homelessness and a crack addiction before he got clean in 2010. Saturn also shared infamous backstage stories, including a knife-pulling incident with Mike Graham in WCW, the truth behind the Moppy gimmick as punishment for an unscripted attack on Mike Bell, and wild claims regarding Terri Runnels and Jim Ross in WWE.

stories.title: Pennsylvania Man Scammed Out of Money by Rhea Ripley Impersonator
stories.tldr: A 64-year-old Pennsylvania man was scammed out of $42,700 in March by individuals impersonating WWE star Rhea Ripley. Initial local news reports mistakenly claimed the loss was $427,000 before quietly correcting the figure. The unidentified victim has refused to cooperate with the Pennsylvania State Police investigation, and no arrests have been made. This incident highlights a recurring issue of online fraud in professional wrestling, similar to past cases where fans lost massive sums to impersonators.

stories.title: The Rock Unlikely for WrestleMania 43 Build
stories.tldr: WWE creative is currently operating under the assumption that Dwayne The Rock Johnson will not be available for substantial storyline participation or an in-ring match at WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia. Reports indicate that his heavy filming schedule for the upcoming Fast and Furious franchise installment, Fast Forever, makes a wrestling return very unlikely. While sources emphasize that plans involving The Rock can change in an instant, the company is currently mapping out its historic first international WrestleMania without him.

stories.title: Nikki Bella, Brie Bella, and Paige WWE Storyline Plans
stories.tldr: Following their shocking betrayal of Paige at SummerSlam 2026, Nikki and Brie Bella ignited a heated feud. While Brie continues recovering from a broken scapula sustained at the premium live event, Nikki recently faced Paige in a surprisingly brief singles match on SmackDown. Nikki revealed on her podcast that she had originally prepared for a much longer match, but she embraced the short duration as a creative storytelling choice to generate strong heat and leave fans wanting more.

stories.title: WWE Unveils New Performance Center Recruit Class Including Aalyah Mysterio
stories.tldr: WWE has officially announced its newest class of Performance Center recruits reporting to Orlando, Florida, headlined by Aalyah Gutierrez, the daughter of Rey Mysterio and sister of Dominik Mysterio. Training under her real name, Gutierrez joins a diverse group of six other new talents from various athletic, amateur wrestling, and independent backgrounds. Notable additions include former TNA referee Katie Reynolds, former WWE ID talent Zoe Sager, and Australian independent standouts Jackson Goonrey and Tyran Tuckey. This fresh wave of signings arrives shortly after a recent round of roster releases and main roster departures in the company.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes Promotes Street Fighter Movie With Popcorn Bucket
stories.tldr: WWE star Cody Rhodes has unveiled an unusual AMC Theatres exclusive popcorn bucket shaped like his character Guile's iconic blond hair for the upcoming Street Fighter movie. The wearable, helmet-like collectible was showcased in a promotional video featuring Rhodes alongside his co-stars Noah Centineo and Callina Liang. The star-studded film, which also features fellow WWE Superstar Roman Reigns as Akuma, is scheduled to hit theaters on October 16 with tickets going on sale Monday.

stories.title: Logan Paul WWE Return Timeline Following Injury
stories.tldr: Logan Paul is expected to make his in-ring WWE return around November as he continues to recover from a complete tear of his left triceps tendon sustained on May 23. Although Paul has joked on his vlog about being ready to return sooner, WWE official Michael Hayes and Triple H, along with orthopedic surgeon Dr. Jeffrey Dugas, confirmed that the biology of his elbow requires a full five and a half to six months of healing. Once he is finally cleared, creative plans for his return could include resuming his tag team success with Austin Theory in The Vision, entering into new feuds with stars like Oba Femi or Chad Gable, or pursuing a world championship match against Roman Reigns.

stories.title: Paul Heyman Sit-Down Interview With Graham Bensinger
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Paul Heyman has announced via Instagram Stories that he will participate in an upcoming sit-down interview with journalist Graham Bensinger for In Depth with Graham Bensinger. The long-form interview format will provide Heyman the opportunity to share stories from his legendary four-decade career outside of his usual television setting. While an official air date has not yet been revealed, fans eagerly anticipate hearing his insights on ECW, creative behind-the-scenes work, and monumental modern storylines like The Bloodline.

stories.title: Top Selling WWE Merchandise Stars for Kids
stories.tldr: A recent analysis of WWEShop.com reveals surprising trends in WWE merchandise sales among children, with perennial top sellers like Roman Reigns, Cody Rhodes, Rhea Ripley, Alexa Bliss, and Jey Uso joined by notable risers. While established names continue to dominate adult and child demographics alike, newer talents such as Oba Femi and Penta are capturing the imagination of younger fans. In particular, Penta has emerged as the clear leader, dominating the top spots for both kids and adult apparel following stellar performances.

stories.title: Ethan Page Discusses Shift in Personal Goals in WWE
stories.tldr: WWE star Ethan Page recently discussed how his career priorities have evolved over his two-decade journey in professional wrestling. While he still aims to capture major championships like the Intercontinental and world titles, his ultimate ambition is to build a lasting legacy and earn the deep respect of his peers. By highlighting legendary figures who never won a world title but still hold immense industry value, Page emphasized that a strong overall body of work matters most.

stories.title: Total Divas Reboot Casting Rumors
stories.tldr: Rumors are swirling about a potential reboot of the reality television series Total Divas featuring a fresh lineup of WWE talent alongside possible returning veterans. The proposed next generation cast highlights a diverse group of performers including Maxxine Dupri, backstage interviewer Cathy Kelley, and rising stars like Lash Legend, Blake Monroe, and Fallon Henley. Each potential cast member brings a unique perspective, from established locker room friendships and NXT journeys to main roster transitions and built in stable dynamics. This new era of the show aims to capture the modern landscape of women in professional wrestling both inside the ring and behind the scenes.

stories.title: Potential New Tag Team Formations on WWE Main Roster
stories.tldr: A recent report explores potential new tag team formations on the WWE main roster to revitalize struggling solo acts and provide fresh character development. The proposed pairings include Seth Rollins teaming with Oba Femi to target The Vision, Ivy Nile joining forces with Jordynne Grace following internal company pitches, and an odd couple pairing of Ricky Saints and Danhausen on SmackDown. These combinations aim to inject new energy into the tag team division while helping talents connect with the audience and achieve new common goals.

stories.title: Booker T Weighs In on Importance of World Titles
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Booker T recently discussed the true significance of holding a world championship on his podcast. He explained that being chosen for the top spot means the company trusts you to lead them upward and that high pay should naturally follow. Booker emphasized that the actual title carries a lasting legacy far beyond physical hardware, noting that people still respectfully address him as champ on a regular basis.

stories.title: WWE Crown Jewel Status Amid Saudi Arabia Travel Advisory
stories.tldr: Following a recent U.S. State Department travel advisory for Saudi Arabia due to potential Iranian drone and missile threats, WWE is internally discussing the status of Crown Jewel on November 7. While the company is weighing whether it is safe to send talent and personnel to Riyadh, the event is expected to proceed on that date anyway due to broadcast commitments with ESPN. Observers note that even if the location changes or the event is postponed, WWE will not lose its reported multi-million dollar payout, as the missed date would simply be added to the end of their contractual obligations.

stories.title: Roman Reigns vs. Penta Backstage Update and Rematch Status
stories.tldr: While an immediate rematch between Roman Reigns and Penta is not currently planned, WWE views the pairing as a major program that could headline a future Premium Live Event. Penta has solidified his main-event status internally, though Reigns has already moved on to a championship defense against LA Knight at Money in the Bank. Meanwhile, their Mexico City encounter shattered company records by pulling in over 74 million social media views in less than a day.

stories.title: WWE x AAA Worlds Collide Broadcast Plans and Faction Changes
stories.tldr: WWE and AAA are moving forward with their September 26 Worlds Collide event in Rosemont against AEW All Out, with new updates clarifying its broadcast status and match card. While official live streaming plans remain unconfirmed, backstage reports indicate the event is being filmed with commentary. Meanwhile, the five-match card features major cross-promotional bouts that could spark significant faction changes for groups like The Judgment Day.

stories.title: Kelani Jordan Makes WWE Raw Debut and Main Roster Plans
stories.tldr: Kelani Jordan's recent appearance on Raw was reportedly designed to introduce the current NXT Women's Champion to a mainstream television audience ahead of a permanent main roster call-up. Backstage plans indicate her transition to Raw or SmackDown will happen once her current title run concludes, with late 2026 being targeted internally by WWE officials. Analysts are already speculating on potential opponents and creative directions for her eventual full-time arrival.

stories.title: WWE Future Plans in Mexico and TripleMania Weekend Events
stories.tldr: Following this year's successful crossover events, WWE is already eyeing a repeat performance in Mexico. The promotion is reportedly planning to bookend next year's TripleMania 35 with live television broadcasts of Raw and SmackDown. Executives were thrilled with the strong ticket sales, robust merchandise numbers, and overall fan enthusiasm during the recent Arena CDMX takeover.

stories.title: WWE Expansion Plans and Major 2028 Event in Perth, Australia
stories.tldr: Building on its upcoming December events in Western Australia, WWE has reportedly agreed to a three-year partnership with Perth that includes annual Premium Live Event weekends through 2028. Backstage reports indicate that the multi-year deal could culminate in a major traditional Big Four event, with the Royal Rumble or Survivor Series specifically under consideration for the 2028 window. While nothing is officially finalized for that final year yet, the arrangement guarantees full television takeovers with SmackDown and Raw accompanying each annual PLE.

stories.title: Jonathan Coachman Criticizes Sami Zayn's WWE Championship Run
stories.tldr: Jonathan Coachman is doubling down on his criticism regarding Sami Zayn holding the Undisputed WWE Championship, arguing that not everyone is built to be a world champion and pointing to issues of character perception. Hall of Famer Jim Ross also weighed in by questioning if Zayn possesses enough mass appeal to consistently headline WrestleMania as the top guy. Meanwhile, Zayn recently reflected on his second title victory, noting that recapturing the championship proved his initial brief run was no fluke.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes Creative Discussions and Production in WWE
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes recently shared more details about his past creative pitches and backstage relationships during a conversation with Simone Johnson. He revealed that Bruce Prichard vetoed a bizarre idea for him to return wearing a black cowboy hat to attack John Cena and Logan Paul. Rhodes also discussed his rocky dynamic with former WWE writer Brian Gewirtz, whom he believes was never really a fan of his work. Despite these creative missteps and friction, Rhodes emphasized how much he values being produced.

stories.title: Simone Johnson (Ava) Reflects on NXT GM Role and Backstage Work
stories.tldr: Building on her recent transition from WWE to Seven Bucks Productions, former NXT General Manager Simone Johnson has shared new details about her corporate role and her time in the ring. She revealed that her junior executive position has brought her closer to her mother Dany Garcia while teaching her the intricacies of film and television development. Johnson also opened up about dealing with intense fan backlash when her father Dwayne The Rock Johnson took Cody Rhodes WrestleMania spot, and named Ethan Page as her favorite on-screen counterpart in NXT.

stories.title: Netflix Edits Fan Reactions and Audio on WWE RAW Replays
stories.tldr: Netflix has significantly altered the replay of the Mexico City WWE RAW episode by censoring crowd audio and visual elements. Viewers watching the replay missed out on the massive, thunderous ovation given to new AAA Mega Champion El Grande Americano because his crowd volume was noticeably dialed down. Additionally, the streaming platform scrubbed various NSFW fan insults from the broadcast, including explicit chants directed at Liv Morgan.

stories.title: WWE Main Roster Teams Entering 2026 NXT Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic
stories.tldr: The 2026 NXT Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic is taking shape with newly confirmed participants and crucial first-round byes. General Manager Robert Stone revealed that reigning champions The Wagner Brothers and The Vanity Project will automatically advance to the quarterfinals. Speculation is also mounting regarding which Raw and SmackDown tandems, such as Fraxiom and the LWO, will fill out the rest of the main roster slots.

stories.title: Potential First-Time WWE Women's World Champions
stories.tldr: Following Chelsea Green becoming an interim champion at SummerSlam, WWE is positioning several female stars to capture their first world titles soon. Five names leading this potential breakthrough include Lola Vice and Sol Ruca, who recently qualified for the upcoming Money in the Bank ladder match. Additionally, main roster standouts Jacy Jayne, Roxanne Perez, and Lash Legend are being heavily featured in top title pictures and high-profile storylines.

stories.title: WWE Is Quietly Preparing This NXT Champion for a Main-Roster Move — Report
stories.tldr: Following her recent main-roster television appearance, NXT Women's Champion Kelani Jordan is reportedly being prepped for a permanent move to Raw or SmackDown. While Lola Vice made an immediate full-time jump during the same match, WWE is taking a slower approach with Jordan. Officials plan to keep her in NXT to finish her current championship reign before calling her up permanently.

stories.title: Four WWE stars who could dethrone Roman Reigns for World Heavyweight Championship
stories.tldr: Beyond previous discussions regarding LA Knight, internal creative talks have also evaluated four other potential challengers to eventually dethrone Roman Reigns. Jacob Fatu stands out as a logical choice to keep the title within the Bloodline saga, while rising prospects Oba Femi and Bron Breakker represent a major generational shift. Additionally, Penta has emerged as a dark-horse candidate following strong momentum and potential family involvement.

stories.title: 2 Cold Scorpio Jailed After Bond Violation Ahead of Sentencing
stories.tldr: Former wrestling star Charles 2 Cold Scorpio Scaggs was jailed in Kansas City following a bond revocation hearing. Prosecutors successfully argued that his admission to brandishing a firearm while awaiting sentencing made him a danger to public safety. Scaggs previously agreed to a plea deal for second-degree assault and armed criminal action stemming from a 2024 stabbing incident at a convenience store. He is now being held behind bars as he awaits his sentencing hearing scheduled for October 9.

stories.title: Rich Swann Qualifies for TNA Bound For Glory X-Division Title Match
stories.tldr: Former TNA X-Division Champion Rich Swann has punched his ticket to Bound For Glory by defeating LJ Cleary on TNA Impact. Swann joins KC Navarro, Fabian Aichner, and Cedric Alexander in the upcoming six-way scramble match for the vacant title. The championship was recently vacated when Leon Slater exercised Option C to challenge TNA World Champion Nic Nemeth at the October event. Two qualifying spots remain open for the high-stakes pay-per-view in Tampa, Florida.

stories.title: Eddie Edwards Challenges Ricky Sosa for TNA Bound For Glory
stories.tldr: Following a heated tag team match on the September 17 episode of TNA iMPACT where Ricky Sosa pinned Cedric Alexander, Eddie Edwards and The System brutally attacked Sosa and Elijah. Edwards capped off the assault with a package piledriver and officially challenged the rising star to a singles match. This upcoming clash at TNA Bound For Glory on October 11 will mark Sosa's first-ever singles match on the main card of a TNA pay-per-view, adding a major chapter to their ongoing rivalry.

stories.title: MLW Fusion Lands New Weekly Streaming Deal on Tubi
stories.tldr: Major League Wrestling has announced a new weekly streaming deal for MLW Fusion on the free ad-supported platform Tubi, with episodes airing on Thursday nights. This move comes shortly after the expiration of MLW's previous television agreement and years after a potential Tubi partnership famously became a focal point of MLW's antitrust lawsuit against WWE. The promotion's free YouTube broadcasts are expected to continue alongside the new Tubi distribution. Tubi now joins a growing wrestling ecosystem on the platform that also features content from other major promotions.

stories.title: TNA Impact September 17 Highlights and Air Time
stories.tldr: The September 17, 2026 episode of TNA Impact on AMC, broadcasting at 9pm Eastern and globally, served as the final stop from the Brampton, Ontario tapings on the road to Bound For Glory. The eventful card featured M By Elegance successfully defending the Knockouts Television Championship against Kiera Hogan and a high-stakes main event where Moose put his career on the line against Frankie Kazarian. While the show delivered solid action including an X-Division qualifier and various tag matches, it also ended with mysterious attackers laying out Matt Hardy.

stories.title: Moose Defeats Frankie Kazarian to Save TNA Career
stories.tldr: Moose successfully saved his TNA career by defeating Frankie Kazarian in the main event of the September 17 episode of Thursday Night iMPACT on AMC. Kazarian had only agreed to the bout after Moose called him out on the condition that Moose put his career on the line. Utilizing his signature Spear, Moose secured a clean pinfall victory to keep his run with the company alive. Following the match, Moose added insult to injury by smashing the crown that Kazarian frequently carries around.

stories.title: The Fight Game Podcast Final Episode
stories.tldr: Hosts John LaRocca and Dave Marquez have released the final episode of The Fight Game Podcast on their network, marking the end of a long-running era. The hosts dedicated the first part of the show to reflecting on the history of the program and expressing gratitude to key figures in the wrestling media community. For their final segment, they kept things overwhelmingly positive by giving out only thumbs up while breaking down major wrestling topics of the week.

stories.title: AAA Announces Date and Location for Guerra De Titanes 2026
stories.tldr: AAA has officially announced the date and location for its upcoming Guerra De Titanes 2026 event. The annual year-end finale is scheduled for December 19, 2026, returning to Guadalajara, Mexico, following the success of the previous year's show. Tickets are currently on sale, while broadcast plans indicate the event will stream for free on YouTube internationally and air on Fox in Latin America.

stories.title: Brooke Havok Suffers Torn ACL and Meniscus
stories.tldr: Independent wrestling standout Brooke Havok has suffered a severe setback after tearing her ACL and meniscus during a September 4 event in Philadelphia. The injury requires surgery and a lengthy recovery, leaving her without wrestling income while medical bills accumulate. In response, fellow wrestler Jonathan Gresham has launched a GoFundMe campaign to help cover her expenses. Gresham stepped up to return the favor after Havok previously helped him find his way back to the ring following his own health scare involving two strokes in 2025.

stories.title: M By Elegance Retains TNA Knockouts TV Championship
stories.tldr: M By Elegance successfully defended her TNA Knockouts Television Championship against Kiera Hogan on the latest episode of TNA Impact. Accompanied by The Elegance Brand, the champion overcame a fierce challenge from Hogan, who was supported by her Knockouts Tag Team partner Allie. After a fast-paced 10-minute encounter featuring near falls and high-impact maneuvers, M secured the victory by catching Hogan off the ropes and dropping her with a decisive piledriver. The title will continue to be exclusively defended on Impact programming moving forward.

stories.title: Wrestler Spotlight on RCW Champion Tyler 'By God' Matthews
stories.tldr: RCW Heavyweight Champion Tyler By God Matthews recently retained his title at Swinging for the Fences in South Bend, where his hometown crowd passionately cheered him despite his villainous persona. In a career-spanning interview conducted while sitting in a delivery room, Matthews discussed his wrestling philosophy, early inspirations, and key trainers who shaped his psychological approach to the ring. Shortly after the interview concluded, Matthews and his family celebrated the birth of his first child, marking a monumental milestone both professionally and personally.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling Thunder Vision Episode 2 Released
stories.tldr: Pro Wrestling Thunder has released the second episode of its Thunder Vision series on its newly launched YouTube channel, featuring a match between Leela Feist and The Hidden Gem Mika. This digital expansion allows the Huntington, Indiana-based independent promotion to showcase its roster to fans outside its regular live-event schedule. The recurring series provides a steady entry point for new viewers to discover regional talent, including Feist following her recent return from a broken collarbone.

stories.title: Bryan Alvarez Hosts Granny Memoir Reading Event
stories.tldr: Wrestling journalist Bryan Alvarez recently hosted a special live event at the retirement community where Granny resides. Accompanied by Vinny, Bryan presented a public reading of Granny's memoirs for her fellow residents. The presentation was followed by an interactive live question and answer session with the audience. Fans can now listen to an audio recording of this unique and entertaining community event.

stories.title: El Hijo del Vikingo Recovery Timeline Following ACL Surgery
stories.tldr: AAA star El Hijo del Vikingo has provided a new recovery update on Instagram as he rehabilitates from surgery to repair a torn ACL. The high-flying star shared a video receiving knee treatment and estimated that he has seven months left until he is fully healed. The injury previously forced him to miss a scheduled title defense on WWE NXT, but he continues to make positive progress with the support of his family, therapists, and promotions.

stories.title: Matchroom Boxing Promoter Eddie Hearn Responds to Dana White
stories.tldr: Matchroom Boxing promoter Eddie Hearn has fired back at UFC President Dana White following accusations that Hearn is trying to sabotage the potential super fight between Anthony Joshua and Tyson Fury. White previously claimed that Hearn was hindering the historic British matchup and attempted to move the bout to the United States. Hearn dismissed White's interference, stating that White has no business meddling in negotiations or attempting to break existing contracts. Hearn emphasized that Joshua is committed to honoring his agreement and keeping the monumental fight in the UK for British fans rather than chasing a larger payday in America.

stories.title: TNA Talent Turnover and Potential WWE Free Agent Signings
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling is eyeing former Wyatt Sicks members Joe Gacy and Dexter Lumis for upcoming television tapings, building on ongoing talent roster shifts. Meanwhile, the promotion faces potential major departures at the end of 2026 as top stars like Knockouts Champion Xia Brookside, Elayna Black, and rising standout Leon Slater approach free agency with possible WWE interest looming.

stories.title: Jeff Cobb Confirms WWE Contract Status During 2025 NJPW Tour
stories.tldr: Jeff Cobb has clarified that his abrupt departure from New Japan Pro Wrestling in April 2025 was due to his binding WWE contract, forcing him to exit before he could finish the Wrestling Dontaku tour. Cobb addressed lingering tension with Callum Newman over his sudden exit and subsequent return, noting that Newman should perhaps thank him for opening up opportunities. Looking ahead, Cobb is scheduled to settle his differences with Newman in a singles match at NJPW Destruction in Kobe.

stories.title: Maple Leaf Pro Title Change and Gisele Shaw Signing
stories.tldr: Gisele Shaw recently signed an exclusive contract with the National Wrestling Alliance and captured their Women's Television Championship. Following that news, it was revealed that Shaw dropped the Maple Leaf Pro Women's Championship to Priscilla Kelly. Kelly will now defend that title against Nikki Storm at MLP Northern Rising, where Josh Alexander and Stu Grayson also meet to crown an undisputed Canadian Champion.

stories.title: Adam Page and Brodido Earn AEW World Trios Title Shot at All Out
stories.tldr: Hangman Adam Page and Brodido, consisting of Brody King and Bandido, earned an AEW World Trios Championship match at All Out by defeating The Conglomeration on AEW Dynamite. They currently await their opponents, who will be decided when Swerve Strickland and New Level defend the titles against The Demand on the September 23 episode. Meanwhile, several other high-profile matches and eliminators have been added to the All Out card in Chicago.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné Ruled Out of AEW All Out Due to Injury; Eliminator Set
stories.tldr: AEW Women’s World Champion Mercedes Moné has been ruled out of the upcoming All Out pay-per-view because she is not medically cleared to compete following a reported broken nose sustained at All In. To determine her next challenger, AEW has booked a high-stakes eliminator match between Willow Nightingale and Thekla for the event. The winner of this bout will advance to challenge Moné for the championship at WrestleDream on October 17, pending the champion's medical clearance.

stories.title: Maya World Sidelined Following Recent Medical Procedure
stories.tldr: Former AEW TBS Champion Maya World is currently sidelined after undergoing an undisclosed medical procedure over the past week. The 24-year-old star has been forced to pull out of several independent bookings and upcoming appearances, including the September 16 episode of AEW Dynamite. Despite having no official timetable for her return, backstage sources within AEW are reportedly hopeful that she will be back in the ring soon. Her absence temporarily pauses a red-hot feud involving Britt Baker and Persephone following a breakout summer for the young competitor.

stories.title: Nyla Rose Addresses Oklahoma Athletic Commission and Online Harassment
stories.tldr: Former AEW Women's World Champion Nyla Rose recently criticized the Oklahoma State Athletic Commission and praised AEW President Tony Khan for his public support against discrimination. Rose also called out an Instagram user who sent her harassing, transphobic, and abusive messages online. Furthermore, she discussed her current absence from AEW television while analysts have proposed several potential storylines for her eventual return.

stories.title: The New Level and Kofi/Creed Discuss AEW Debut Experience and Partnership
stories.tldr: During a recent appearance on Close Up with Renee Paquette, The New Level members Austin Creed and Kofi discussed their shocking AEW debut at All In: London 2026 and subsequent partnership with Swerve Strickland. Creed revealed that AEW flew his family out for the event and that they successfully traveled incognito to keep the debut a surprise. The duo also reflected on their 90-day non-compete period following their WWE departure in April, noting that their thriving careers in gaming, conventions, and other media meant they had no financial worries and plenty of family time.

stories.title: Kota Ibushi Requires Additional Femur Surgery But Vows Return to AEW
stories.tldr: AEW star Kota Ibushi has been hospitalized for another surgery on his fractured femur, nearly a year after sustaining the injury during a match against Josh Alexander. Doctors determined that the current plates in his leg are too weak for his body, requiring them to be removed and replaced with the strongest available option. Despite expressing frustration and exhaustion over enduring multiple procedures, the 44-year-old wrestler is refusing to let the setback end his career and has vowed to return to AEW. While he previously hoped to return by late 2026, this latest operation will further delay his in-ring comeback.

stories.title: Jack Perry Calls Out Samoa Joe on AEW Dynamite to Tease His Return
stories.tldr: Jack Perry issued a direct challenge to former AEW World Champion Samoa Joe during a taped promo on AEW Dynamite, telling the absent star to come back and make my day. Joe has been sidelined since May following his match against Will Ospreay at Double or Nothing while filming the third season of Peacock's Twisted Metal. The segment concluded with a camera pan revealing a painted version of the signature Joe is going to kill you chant on a wall, strongly teasing an upcoming feud. Assuming the match is finalized, it will mark the first time Perry and Joe have ever shared a wrestling ring together.

stories.title: AEW Announces Match Cards for Collision and Dynamite Broadcasts
stories.tldr: AEW has announced updated match cards for upcoming episodes of Collision and Dynamite as the company heads toward the All Out pay-per-view. Collision will feature Andrade El Idolo defending the AEW National Championship against Daniel Garcia, alongside Thekla returning to singles action against Zayda Steel with Willow Nightingale on commentary. Meanwhile, Dynamite will showcase an AEW World Trios Championship match with Swerve Strickland and The New Level defending against The Demand. The winners of that bout will move on to defend the titles against Hangman Page, Brody King, and Bandido at All Out.

stories.title: New Matches Official for AEW All Out Card Including Okada vs. Ciampa
stories.tldr: Following the September 16 episode of AEW Dynamite, two major matches have been officially added to the card for AEW All Out 2026. Kazuchika Okada will defend the AEW International Championship against Tommaso Ciampa after a vicious backstage challenge and attack. Additionally, Darby Allin and Steven Borden will face Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight, with the winning team earning a future opportunity at the AEW World Tag Team Championships.

stories.title: Potential Surprises and Debuts Teased for AEW All Out 2026
stories.tldr: As AEW All Out 2026 approaches in Chicago, anticipation is high for Tony Khan to deliver a memorable pay-per-view following the success of All In London. Reports heavily tease major free agent debuts and shocking roster developments, including potential appearances by Ilja Dragunov, Kairi Sane, Dani Luna, and several other former WWE and independent stars. Additionally, internal faction tensions involving the Don Callis Family and the Death Riders are expected to boil over during the event.

stories.title: Reviews and Reactions to the September 16 Episode of AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: The September 16, 2026 episode of AEW Dynamite effectively built momentum toward All Out with strong matches and promising performances, though it faced criticism for a lack of women division variety and a silly necklace feud. Reviewers disliked the ridiculous storyline of Chris Jericho and Nick Wayne fighting over a pooka shell necklace due to its lack of stakes and clunky execution. Conversely, praise went to Steven Borden, known as Baby Sting, for showing great potential and being positioned well alongside veterans like Darby Allin, Adam Copeland, and Christian Cage.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland Reflects on Sacrifices Made During His 17-Year Journey
stories.tldr: AEW star Swerve Strickland recently reflected on the immense personal sacrifices he has made throughout his 17-year professional wrestling career. Starting out at age 18 in 2008, Strickland committed fully to the business with no backup plan, which unfortunately caused him to miss crucial family milestones like his daughters' birthdays. He noted that around years seven and eight, he faced a critical juncture where he wondered if his relentless efforts would ever lead anywhere. Ultimately, those painful sacrifices fueled his historic achievements, including becoming the first Black wrestler to main event Wembley Stadium, winning the World Championship, and securing major mainstream partnerships.

stories.title: Jon Moxley Delivers Warning to Will Ospreay on AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: Jon Moxley delivered a grim warning to AEW World Champion Will Ospreay on Dynamite just ten days before their scheduled title match at All Out. During a segment alongside his Death Riders teammates Gabe Kidd and PAC, Moxley praised Ospreay's recent accomplishments but made it clear that challenging him carries severe consequences. The brewing rivalry exploded into a chaotic six-man main event where Moxley submitted Francesco Akira and refused to break the hold, prompting Ospreay to clear the ring and stand tall as the show went off the air.

stories.title: The Demand Ambushes Swerve Strickland and The New Level on Dynamite
stories.tldr: During the September 16, 2026 episode of AEW Dynamite, Ricochet, Bishop Kaun, and Toa Liona of The Demand launched a brutal surprise attack on Swerve Strickland, Awesome Austin Creed, and Kofi Kingston. The ambush occurred before the group could even make it to the ring, resulting in a vicious dismantling of the champions. The segment concluded with The Demand standing tall over the fallen wrestlers and dropping the tag team titles on top of them to send a definitive message.

stories.title: HBO Max Technical Glitch Impacts AEW Dynamite Viewers
stories.tldr: During the September 16, 2026 episode of AEW Dynamite, a technical glitch on HBO Max locked some Basic With Ads subscribers out of the live stream by demanding an expensive plan upgrade. Frustrated fans took to social media to complain about the unexpected paywall that hit them without any advance warning. Fortunately, users discovered that simple troubleshooting steps, such as restarting a Roku device, could bypass the error and restore access. This incident mirrors previous temporary glitches where basic tier subscribers were incorrectly blocked from watching wrestling programming.

stories.title: Controversial Chants Heard During September 16 AEW Dynamite Broadcast
stories.tldr: During the September 16, 2026 episode of AEW Dynamite, fans briefly chanted Fck ICE as Brody King teamed with Hangman Page and Bandido against Kyle OReilly, Orange Cassidy, and Roderick Strong. This chant has frequently followed King throughout 2026 due to his public anti-ICE messaging, including wearing an Abolish ICE shirt and raising funds for affected immigrant families. Despite the brief crowd disruption, the match carried major stakes as the winners earned an AEW World Trios Championship opportunity at All Out.

stories.title: Chris Jericho Attacked by Nick Wayne After AEW Dynamite Match
stories.tldr: During the September 16, 2026 episode of AEW Dynamite, Chris Jericho defeated Nick Wayne after accidentally destroying Wayne's necklace and capitalizing with a roll-up pin. Furious over both the loss and his damaged heirloom, Wayne rejected Jericho's post-match handshake attempt. Instead, he snapped and launched a vicious steel chair attack on the veteran before leaving him laid out in the ring.

stories.title: Brian Cage PED Usage Comments Raise Questions Regarding AEW Drug Policies
stories.tldr: Current All Elite Wrestling performer Brian Cage recently admitted to using performance-enhancing drugs and relying on long-term Testosterone Replacement Therapy. This admission highlights ongoing questions regarding the existence and enforcement of a wellness or drug testing policy within the promotion. Because the company classifies itself as entertainment rather than a traditional sport, it avoids state athletic commission oversight and independent testing mandates. Industry reports over the years further corroborate that actual drug testing rarely, if ever, occurs within the organization.

stories.title: Last-Minute Match Added to September 16 AEW Dynamite Broadcast
stories.tldr: Tony Khan made a last-minute match announcement shortly before the September 16, 2026 episode of AEW Dynamite in Virginia, adding a high-stakes trios match to the card. Hangman Page, Brody King, and Bandido are set to face Kyle O’Reilly, Orange Cassidy, and Roderick Strong, with the winners earning an immediate path to the AEW World Trios Championship at All Out. This bout kicks off a new tournament-style series where the victorious team will advance to face the winners of next week's title defense between Swerve Strickland's group and their challengers. The surprise addition bolsters an already stacked Dynamite lineup featuring multiple star-studded matches.

stories.title: Tommaso Ciampa Discusses Mark Briscoe Chemistry and AEW Dream Feuds
stories.tldr: Tommaso Ciampa recently reflected on his AEW debut and subsequent program with Mark Briscoe, highlighting their long-standing history and natural in-ring chemistry that immediately picked up where they left off fifteen years ago. Speaking on the Battleground Podcast, Ciampa also revealed his ultimate dream feuds in the company, naming MJF and Jon Moxley as his top choices for extended, multi-month blood feuds. Additionally, he shared a lengthy checklist of future opponents he hopes to step into the ring with, including top stars like Kenny Omega, Will Ospreay, Kazuchika Okada, and Konosuke Takeshita.

stories.title: William Regal Praises PAC as Top English Wrestler Since the 1980s
stories.tldr: WWE executive William Regal recently took to social media to praise AEW star PAC, declaring him the greatest English wrestler to emerge since the 1980s. Regal explained that PAC sets a high standard for credibility and aggression, noting that PAC is the rare modern performer who makes him believe he could win a real fight. He placed PAC in the esteemed company of British legends Rollerball Rocco, Marty Jones, and Fit Finlay while also highlighting one of his favorite matches from the past two decades.

stories.title: Ricky Saints Shares Personal Insights On His In-Ring Weaknesses
stories.tldr: During a recent podcast appearance on Huge Pop with Donnie DaSilva and Jimmy Korderas, wrestler Ricky Saints opened up about the aspects of professional wrestling he feels least confident performing. While generally considering himself a well-rounded performer, Saints admitted that he struggles with high-flying maneuvers from the top rope despite his size and veteran status. He also discussed how he views his in-ring style as a unique blend of various disciplines rather than fitting into one rigid category.

stories.title: AEW Faction Expansions and Roster Dynamics Analysed
stories.tldr: AEW features an abundance of stables, and several prominent groups could soon strengthen their ranks by welcoming back former members. Will Ospreay may rejoin the Death Riders following his complex alliance and upcoming world title match with Jon Moxley. Meanwhile, Wardlow is expected to slot back into the Don Callis Family once he fully recovers from his pectoral injury. Finally, reuniting MJF with The Hurt Syndicate could provide a much-needed creative boost for both parties after a noticeable recent drop in momentum.

stories.title: Tony Schiavone Pays Tribute to Wrestling Legend Superstar Bill Dundee
stories.tldr: AEW announcer Tony Schiavone recently paid heartfelt tribute to the late wrestling legend Bill Dundee on his podcast, What Happened When, following Dundee's passing at age 82. Schiavone praised Dundee's incredible wrestling mind, his legendary booking in the Memphis territory, and his creation of iconic acts like the Midnight Express and the Rock N Roll Express. The two men shared a history as co-workers in WCW during the 1990s and were further connected through Dundee's late son-in-law, Bobby Eaton. Dundee is remembered as a brilliant creative force whose behind-the-scenes work shaped the golden eras of both Memphis wrestling and Jim Crockett Promotions.

stories.title: AEW Releases New Merchandise Capitalizing on Viral Adam Copeland Meme
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling is capitalizing on the recent resurgence of a viral social media meme featuring Adam Copeland. The meme originated from a December 2023 episode of Collision when Copeland casually responded with Aw, dude to a heated promo from Ricky Saints, formerly known as Ricky Starks. After clips recently recirculated and caught the attention of fans and wrestlers alike, the company released a brand new t-shirt on Shop AEW. The official merchandise description even cleverly nods to the original segment by referencing Saints and his famous remarks from the promo.

stories.title: Dani Luna AEW Debut Plans and Potential Matchups Analyzed
stories.tldr: Following her departure from TNA Wrestling in April 2026, Dani Luna is reportedly heading to All Elite Wrestling for the next chapter of her career. Having built a stellar reputation on the independent circuit and in Deadlock Pro-Wrestling, she has several logical opponents waiting for her. Analysts have compiled a list of eight potential wrestlers, ranging from former rivals to established division staples, who could welcome her to the company.

stories.title: AEW Secures New Exclusive Broadcasting Deal in Japan
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling has announced a new exclusive broadcasting partnership in Japan with Hulu Japan starting in November 2026. The platform will stream Dynamite, Collision, and pay-per-view events like Full Gear, following the expiration of AEW's previous agreement with NJPW World in August. While the future of the MyAEW service remains uncertain and questions linger about the tape library and upcoming Forbidden Door events, this deal marks another major step in AEW's ongoing international expansion.

stories.title: Austin Gunn Reveals Promo Coaching Received From Billy Gunn in AEW
stories.tldr: Austin and Colten Gunn recently discussed the extensive coaching they have received from their father, WWE Hall of Famer Billy Gunn, throughout their wrestling careers. During an appearance on Tony Schiavone and Conrad Thompson podcast, Austin revealed that one of his father's primary pet peeves was his tendency to yell constantly during promo delivery. Billy frequently reminded him that holding a microphone eliminates the need to scream to command audience attention. Despite the strict coaching, the Gunn brothers remain key members of AEW's Bang Bang Gang.

stories.title: Ticket Sales Update for September 16 AEW Dynamite Broadcast
stories.tldr: AEW Dynamite is broadcasting live tonight from the Chartway Arena in Norfolk, Virginia, with 2,435 tickets currently distributed according to WrestleTix. This figure reflects a slight decrease of 60 tickets from the previous update due to seats returning in sections 115 and 116. Ticket sales are currently trailing behind the company's previous visit to the venue in April 2025 by approximately 1,500 tickets. Despite the drop, additional sales and walk-ups are expected ahead of the show, which features a loaded card including Chris Jericho versus Nick Wayne and a trios match involving Will Ospreay.

stories.title: Global Start Times Released for AEW All Out 2026 Pay-Per-View
stories.tldr: AEW has officially released the global start times for the upcoming All Out 2026 pay-per-view event. The show emanates from the NOW Arena in Hoffman Estates, Illinois, on Saturday, September 26. Fans across the globe can tune in starting at 8pm Eastern time, with regional conversions provided for time zones ranging from North America to the UK, Europe, Asia, and Australia.

stories.title: Start Time Details Announced for September 16 AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: AEW Dynamite airs tonight live from the Chartway Arena in Norfolk, Virginia, kicking off at 8:00 p.m. Eastern time. The loaded card features Chris Jericho returning to action against Nick Wayne, alongside a major multi-man tag match and women's division action. Fans around the globe can tune in across various time zones, with comprehensive international broadcast schedules now officially confirmed.

stories.title: Uncertainty Surrounding WWE and AAA Worlds Collide Broadcast Plans
stories.tldr: WWE and AAA are holding a Worlds Collide event on September 26 at the Allstate Arena in Rosemont, Illinois, running head-to-head with AEW All Out in the same market. Internal reports indicate that the show may be treated strictly as a live event with no immediate broadcast plans, though things could change and platforms like YouTube or Club WWE remain potential destinations. Meanwhile, a star-studded match card has been advertised featuring local star CM Punk, Rey Mysterio, the newly crowned AAA Mega Champion El Grande Americano, and several other high-profile bouts.

stories.title: Simone Johnson Discusses Her WWE Departure and Future Career Moves
stories.tldr: Simone Johnson, formerly known as Ava in WWE, recently discussed her departure from the company and her new career as a junior executive at Seven Bucks Productions with her parents. During an appearance on Cody Rhodes podcast, she revealed that she still hopes to return to the wrestling ring once she heals from current injuries. She also opened up about the intense fan backlash she faced during the WrestleMania 40 We Want Cody movement and why she ultimately chose not to renew her contract in January.

stories.title: Bronson Reed Reveals Past Injury Setbacks Derailing WrestleMania Plans
stories.tldr: WWE star Bronson Reed recently revealed that unfortunate injury setbacks robbed him of featured matches at each of the past two WrestleMania events. A severe foot injury suffered during WarGames in late 2024 and a biceps tear in early 2026 derailed his momentum heading into the showcase of the immortals. Despite these heartbreaking absences, Reed used his latest recovery period to undergo a massive physical transformation, returning to Raw roughly 100 pounds lighter and targeting a spot in the main event scene.

stories.title: Sami Zayn Scheduled for WWE SmackDown Following Championship Win
stories.tldr: Newly crowned Undisputed WWE Champion Sami Zayn is scheduled to appear on this Friday's episode of WWE SmackDown following his controversial title victory over CM Punk in Mexico City. Zayn captured the gold amidst a chaotic scene involving Kevin Owens, Johnny Gargano, and Candice LeRae, and now faces a massive target on his back with numerous top stars gunning for his championship. The stacked Friday night lineup will also feature an exclusive sit-down interview with Cody Rhodes addressing his recent loss to Randy Orton, alongside continuing Men and Women Money in the Bank qualifying matches.

stories.title: WWE NXT General Manager Announces Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic Teams and Byes
stories.tldr: WWE NXT General Manager Robert Stone has announced the return of the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic, which kicks off on September 22 with a 14-team bracket featuring talent from NXT, AAA, EVOLVE, and the main roster. Speaking on Busted Open Radio, Stone revealed that The Creed Brothers, AAA Tag Team Champions Dr. Wagner Jr. and Galeno, and NXT Tag Team Champions The Vanity Project are confirmed for the field. Due to their championship status, The Vanity Project and the Wagner brothers will both receive first-round byes in the tournament.

stories.title: Seth Rollins Praise Chad Gable Following Intercontinental Title Match
stories.tldr: Seth Rollins recently took to Instagram to offer high praise for WWE Intercontinental Champion Chad Gable, calling him one of the best wrestlers on the planet. This endorsement follows Gable's successful title defense against Dragon Lee on Monday Night Raw during an event in Mexico City. Gable has experienced a major career evolution over the past year and a half, including a notable run under a mask and guidance from The Undertaker that helped him break through. Meanwhile, Rollins has been on a brief hiatus since losing to Roman Reigns at SummerSlam, though he recently returned to the ring during WWE's Latin American house show tour.

stories.title: Sean 'X-Pac' Waltman Details Expanded Backstage Mentoring Role in WWE
stories.tldr: Two-time WWE Hall of Famer Sean X-Pac Waltman revealed that his backstage role with the company has expanded significantly beyond its original scope. What began as a six-hour weekly tape study commitment for independent wrestlers in WWE is ID program has evolved into a comprehensive coaching and mentoring position. Waltman recently discussed these duties on the Six Feet Under podcast, explaining how he uses his past mistakes to guide talent and why he refuses to sugarcoat his blunt critiques. Having overcome past addiction issues, Waltman expressed immense personal and professional fulfillment through his mentoring work, family, and passion for rescuing dogs.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes Details Scrapped Storyline Idea Involving Simone Johnson and The Rock
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes recently revealed a scrapped storyline idea from his feud with Dwayne The Rock Johnson where he would have given his soul to Simone Johnson, formerly known as Ava, instead of The Rock. Under the pitch, Rhodes would have stopped speaking entirely, with the former NXT General Manager acting as his voice. Johnson admitted she never pitched the concept to her father because she was unaware of his sudden return and promo plans at the time. Although the angle never materialized and the feud went in a different direction culminating in John Cena's historic heel turn at Elimination Chamber 2025, Rhodes noted they might still revisit the idea in the future.

stories.title: Wren Sinclair Shares Promo Preparation Methods and Dream WrestleMania Bouts
stories.tldr: Rising WWE NXT star Wren Sinclair recently appeared on Busted Open After Dark to discuss her unique promo preparation methods and her dream WrestleMania opponents. She detailed how she practices using social media clips and memorizing past promos while critiquing common cliches and cadences used by wrestlers. Sinclair also named her former trainer Jazz and fellow WWE star Chelsea Green as her top two dream opponents for the grandest stage. Meanwhile, on television, Sinclair is currently serving a storyline suspension following an attack on NXT Women Champion Kelani Jordan and a referee.

stories.title: Tiffany Stratton Suffers Scary Fall During Live Streaming Practice
stories.tldr: WWE star Tiffany Stratton suffered a frightening fall while practicing dives during a live Twitch streaming session at the Performance Center. While attempting a flip over the top rope to the outside, she under-rotated, struck her head on the apron, and landed awkwardly on her neck. Although the scary incident left her grabbing her neck and prompted immediate concern, she quickly assured fans that she was okay and managed to finish the stream early.

stories.title: MVP Questions Roman Reigns' Mainstream Crossover Appeal Compared to Past Icons
stories.tldr: During a recent episode of his Marking Out podcast, MVP evaluated Roman Reigns and questioned whether his mainstream crossover appeal matches icons like John Cena, The Rock, and Stone Cold Steve Austin. While MVP admitted Reigns may lack that broader household recognition outside of wrestling, he emphasized that Reigns possesses undeniable drawing power and ticket-selling ability within the industry. MVP also rejected Conrad Thompson's label of Reigns as an industry plant, defending the standard office push that builds major stars. Ultimately, MVP predicted that Reigns has the presence, looks, and charisma to eventually transition into a successful acting career in Hollywood.

stories.title: Speculation and Reports Surrounding Roman Reigns' World Title Reign
stories.tldr: WWE creative has internally discussed the possibility of LA Knight defeating Roman Reigns for the World Heavyweight Championship at Money in the Bank on October 10 in New Orleans. The rumored finish could involve interference from Solo Sikoa, costing Reigns the title and serving as a catalyst to finally draw the Tribal Chief into the developing WarGames storyline. While this scenario has been bandied about backstage, it remains strictly an idea and is not yet a confirmed plan.

stories.title: Backstage WWE Reaction to Penta's In-Ring Performance Against Roman Reigns
stories.tldr: Penta made a massive impression on WWE management following his World Heavyweight Championship match against Roman Reigns on Monday Night Raw in Mexico City. Backstage executives were thrilled with his ability to command the crowd, reinforcing the belief that he is a future World Champion and a major long-term draw. The event itself was a major box office success, potentially setting a revenue record for Arena CDMX. Furthermore, wrestling legend Bully Ray praised the bout as superior to Reigns' WrestleMania match with CM Punk and defended its dramatic finishing sequence.

stories.title: Becky Lynch Explains the Inspiration Behind 'The Man' Moniker
stories.tldr: Becky Lynch recently appeared on the Boy Talk Talk Show to discuss the true inspiration behind her iconic WWE nickname, The Man. She explained that the moniker was never meant to be taken literally, but rather referenced the common idiom that someone at the top of their profession is considered the man, citing examples like Tom Brady and Ric Flair. When the hosts jokingly suggested the persona was simply about making money and having fun rather than advancing women's progress, a flustered Lynch playfully retorted before moving on. The character originated in 2018 and played a massive role in elevating her to unprecedented levels of popularity in the company.

stories.title: Brie Bella Provides Injury Recovery Update Regarding Scapula Fracture
stories.tldr: Brie Bella has provided an encouraging update on her recovery from the broken scapula she suffered during her match at SummerSlam. Speaking on her podcast, the WWE Hall of Famer noted that her rehab is progressing well as she works toward a crucial doctor evaluation on October 1. That upcoming medical check could finally clear her to begin light workouts and determine her eventual in-ring return timeline. Meanwhile, her sister Nikki continues their ongoing feud with Paige on television.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Live Reports on WWE NXT and Booking Decisions
stories.tldr: Wrestling Observer Live recently discussed WWE booking strategies, specifically focusing on the concept of risk taking and the upcoming Worlds Collide event. Bryan Alvarez and Filthy Tom Lawlor questioned the strategic purpose behind holding the Worlds Collide show during the broadcast. Additionally, the episode covered an NXT television report featuring notable comedic segments. Subscribers can also access Alvarez's detailed written report on the September 15 edition of WWE NXT.

stories.title: Stephanie Vaquer Comments on WWE Absence and Representation Goals
stories.tldr: WWE Women's World Champion Stephanie Vaquer recently opened up about her challenging recovery following post WrestleMania 42 surgery and her triumphant return to television and the ring. Reflecting on her time away, she admitted that being unable to train was the hardest thing she has ever experienced, though stepping back into the ring felt like coming back to life. Alongside her physical recovery, Vaquer discussed her representation goals, expressing her strong desire to pave the way for more Chilean talent in WWE. Having recently regained her championship in Chile alongside fellow wrestler La Catalina, she hopes to see many more of her countrymen signed following recent WWE tryouts.

stories.title: Sami Zayn Addresses Critics Saying He Doesn't Look Like a Typical Champion
stories.tldr: Reigning two-time Undisputed WWE Champion Sami Zayn recently addressed critics who claim he does not possess the traditional look of a top-tier wrestling champion. During an appearance on Busted Open, Zayn argued that a physique and in-ring moves are merely tools designed to achieve the ultimate goal of getting fans emotionally invested. Pointing to his recent championship victory over CM Punk in Mexico City and his extensive history of compelling storytelling, Zayn emphasized that audience connection is the true measure of success in professional wrestling.

stories.title: CM Punk Breaks Down What Makes Top Wrestling Superstars Stand Out
stories.tldr: During a recent appearance on Hot Ones Extra Heat, CM Punk discussed the unique qualities that separate ordinary wrestlers from true top-tier superstars. He explained that while the physical mechanics and moves of professional wrestling can easily be taught, innate charisma and presence are unteachable intangibles. Punk highlighted The Rock as a prime example of someone who naturally possessed entertaining qualities long before he ever learned how to run the ropes. Additionally, Punk briefly opened up about his ongoing struggles with vertigo during the interview.

stories.title: Janel Grant Shares Update Following Severe Accident
stories.tldr: Former WWE employee Janel Grant made her first public appearance since suffering a severe accident approximately six weeks prior while accepting the 2026 Advocacy in Action Award from the Connecticut Alliance to End Sexual Violence. Grant, who filed a federal lawsuit against Vince McMahon in January 2024 alleging sexual assault and sex trafficking, revealed she nearly died after tripping on a carpet runner and striking a wooden bed frame while living alone. She detailed severe injuries including a concussion, broken ribs, a lung hemorrhage, and facial trauma, stating she is very lucky to have a pulse. Despite her ongoing struggles and the lingering impact of a nondisclosure agreement, Grant expressed deep gratitude for the community and support system that ultimately stepped in to save her life.

stories.title: Logan Paul Outlines WWE Goals Prior to Potential Conor McGregor Fight
stories.tldr: Logan Paul has revealed his ultimate career plan, which involves capturing the WWE Championship before pursuing a high-profile crossover fight against former UFC champion Conor McGregor. During a recent interview, Paul outlined his ambition to return to WWE as a reigning champion after defeating McGregor in combat sports. Although a potential fight with McGregor has previously stalled due to contractual issues, Paul remains confident in his ability to beat the MMA star. For now, capturing WWE's top prize remains unfinished business as Paul continues to balance his wrestling career with other ventures.

stories.title: Kendal Grey Faces Delay in WWE NXT In-Ring Return
stories.tldr: Former NXT Women Champion Kendal Grey is facing further delays in her in-ring return as she continues to recover from an ear and vestibular system injury. During a recent backstage evaluation on WWE NXT, her doctor denied her medical clearance due to persistent vertigo, dizziness, and anxiety. The underlying injury occurred during an NXT Underground Match against Lola Vice on August 4, where Grey hit her head on the steel steps but continued to wrestle before eventually losing her title later that month. Currently, there is no set timeline for her return to the ring, and she has been advised to consult a sports psychologist.

stories.title: Sami Zayn Celebrates Undisputed WWE Title Win with Refrigerator Photo
stories.tldr: Sami Zayn recently defeated CM Punk on SmackDown to capture his second Undisputed WWE Championship, ending Punk's 64-day reign. To celebrate the victory, Zayn posted a photo on social media of the title belt sitting inside his refrigerator. This image was a direct callback to Punk's famous 2011 championship celebration and his recent recreation of it earlier this year. As of now, Punk has not publicly responded to the clever trolling from the new champion.

stories.title: Ethan Page Details His On-Screen WWE Partnership with Rusev
stories.tldr: Ethan Page has opened up about his on-screen WWE partnership with Rusev, explaining that despite being an unlikely pairing on the surface, they share several key commonalities. Page noted that their outlooks on the Raw brand align, they hate the same people, share identical professional goals, and both have southeastern European family backgrounds as Balkans. Following their recent tag team matches together, Rusev is currently sidelined with an injury he sustained in late July.

stories.title: Jasmin St. Claire Criticizes Janel Grant Over Public Statements
stories.tldr: Jasmin St. Claire launched a harsh attack on Janel Grant via social media, telling her to stop mocking real-life victims after Grant spoke about her ongoing physical and financial struggles following her turmoil involving Vince McMahon and WWE. St. Claire accused Grant of lying about being broke and claimed that Grant ruined a financial arrangement by speaking publicly about it. While St. Claire provided no evidence for her claims regarding McMahon or alleged payments, her public outburst directly challenges Grant's ongoing survivor advocacy and her recent receipt of an advocacy award.

stories.title: Lil Yachty Reflects on His WWE Saturday Night's Main Event Match
stories.tldr: Rapper Lil Yachty recently reflected on his in-ring debut at Saturday Night's Main Event, where he successfully survived a five-minute match against Baron Corbin to secure a United States Championship opportunity for Trick Williams. Despite months of training at the WWE Performance Center and feeling calm on the day of the event, Yachty admitted during an interview that re-watching the match made him wish he had added more flair, taunted the crowd, and adjusted his mannerisms. Fortunately, he received widespread praise backstage, including two congratulatory hugs from Paul Triple H Levesque, reinforcing his genuine passion for the pro wrestling industry.

stories.title: WWE Reportedly Planning Major Push for Select Roster Members in 2026
stories.tldr: WWE creative is reportedly planning major upward momentum for several roster members under Triple H throughout 2026, following breakout years for stars like Oba Femi and Trick Williams. The article highlights six specific talents positioned for future success, including high-fliers, NXT call-ups, and main event players. Names such as Dragon Lee, Rey Fenix, Penta, Lola Vice, JeVon Evans, and Royce Keys are all being heavily backed by backstage management as potential future world champions and top-tier acts.

stories.title: WWE Reportedly Preparing Early Announcement for Hall of Fame 2027
stories.tldr: Following last year's early announcement of Stephanie McMahon for the 2026 class, WWE may establish a new tradition by revealing their 2027 Hall of Fame headliner months in advance. Industry speculation has already turned toward potential inductees who recently finished their in-ring careers or hold deep family ties to the company. Top contenders for the 2027 class include recently retired legend John Cena, legacy figure Shane McMahon, and former universal champion Brock Lesnar. A formal announcement could arrive in the coming months to kick off the next induction cycle.

stories.title: Potential WWE Roster Changes and Faction Ideas for Cody Rhodes
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes recently suffered a costly defeat against Randy Orton at WWE Sunday Night's Main Event after hesitating to deliver a punt kick, paving the way for Orton to challenge Sami Zayn. To revitalize his career and adopt a fresh approach, Rhodes could form a new heel faction on the SmackDown brand. Speculation suggests he might recruit real-life friends Ricky Saints and Ethan Page alongside veteran manager Paul Heyman to establish a powerful new stable.

stories.title: CM Punk Discusses Lingering Effects from Past Skull Fracture
