stories.tldr: Former Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk revealed in a recent interview that he still suffers from severe vertigo as a lingering effect of a past skull fracture. Punk explained that the injury displaced bones in his inner ear that control equilibrium, causing sudden dizzy spells that he has secretly battled through during many of his matches. He even joked that he will now blame the crookedness of his moonsault against Cody Rhodes on the condition.

stories.title: Roxanne Perez Expresses Interest in Facing AJ Lee in WWE
stories.tldr: WWE star Roxanne Perez has expressed a strong desire to face AJ Lee in a marquee singles match. Speaking in a recent interview, Perez not only welcomed the opportunity to be Lee's next opponent, but she also made it clear that she wants to be the one to retire her. This potential feud draws heavily from Perez's lifelong fandom of Lee and CM Punk, setting up a compelling narrative for when Lee eventually returns to the company.

stories.title: Paul Heyman's On-Screen Future with WWE's The Vision Under Discussion
stories.tldr: Paul Heyman's current alliance with The Vision is facing uncertainty following a mysterious phone call during Sunday Night's Main Event. Speculation is running wild about whether the Hall of Famer will ditch his current stable for a fresh high profile partnership. Analysts and fans have narrowed down three prime candidates who could become the next Paul Heyman client. Those potential superstars include Oba Femi, Cody Rhodes, and Drew McIntyre.

stories.title: Tony D'Angelo Main Roster Call-Up Speculation Follows NXT Defeat
stories.tldr: Following another pivotal loss in a number one contender match on NXT, speculation is mounting regarding a potential main roster call-up for longtime brand staple Tony D'Angelo. Mason Rook secured the pinfall over D'Angelo in a triple threat match also involving Saquon Shugars, echoing similar recent big-match defeats. After spending five years developing his craft on Tuesday nights, analysts are eyeing potential pathways for D'Angelo on Raw or SmackDown. These possibilities range from aligning with or opposing Oba Femi to entering the United States Championship picture.

stories.title: Bully Ray Discusses Recently Returned WWE Talent's Momentum
stories.tldr: Following his return to WWE earlier this summer, Big Cass suffered a notable defeat on a recent episode of Raw during a Men's Money in the Bank qualifying match. Je'Von Evans secured the pinfall victory over the seven-foot wrestler in a triple threat match that also featured Austin Theory. Wrestling veteran Bully Ray expressed concern on radio that this decisive finish and subsequent appearance on Main Event might signal an early end to Cass's recent push. Ray argued that while losses happen, the manner in which Evans dominated and pinned the giant was unnecessarily damaging to his momentum.

stories.title: Potential First-Time World Champions Highlighted on WWE Roster
stories.tldr: A new roster overview highlights ten standout WWE Raw and SmackDown stars who are positioned to become first-time world champions. The list features a mix of rising up-and-coming talents, established mid-card champions, and impactful veterans. Names like Penta, Roxanne Perez, and Trick Williams are just a few examples of competitors ready to break through to the main event scene.

stories.title: Retrospective Review of WWE Hell in a Cell 2018 PPV
stories.tldr: Looking back at the September 16, 2018 Hell in a Cell pay per view reveals a surprisingly strong card despite the over-saturation of gimmick shows during that decade. Critics praised the event for its well-paced eight-match lineup where every bout received adequate time and delivered high-quality wrestling without the show ever dragging. The standout encounter of the night was the Raw Tag Team Championship match, where Dolph Ziggler and Drew McIntyre successfully retained their titles against Seth Rollins and Dean Ambrose in a critically acclaimed bout.

stories.title: Grayson Waller Comments on Australia Show Omission and Calls CM Punk Soft
stories.tldr: Grayson Waller recently revealed that being left off WWE's major 2025 Australia shows was the lowest point of his main-roster run despite his heavy media efforts and patriotic gear. During a recent interview, he also addressed his ongoing friction with CM Punk, acknowledging Punk's behind-the-scenes helpfulness with younger talent while criticizing this new persona as soft. Waller expressed a strong desire to test himself against the confrontational, sharper version of Punk he grew up watching rather than the current backstage mentor. Ultimately, Waller wants to step up to the best in the world to see if that classic competitive edge is still alive.

stories.title: Donovan Dijak Recalls Early WWE Tryout Experience
stories.tldr: Donovan Dijak recently reflected on his career, noting that signing with WWE after his very first tryout in 2013 would have drastically changed his wrestling style. He credits the independent circuit with giving him the freedom to experiment and fail without high-stakes career consequences. During the same interview, Dijak shared the bizarre story of how a viral social media post led to him wrestling on an unstable, floating ring at BZW WaterMania in Paris. He detailed the unique physical challenges of performing on a water-bound structure that wobbled and sank under pressure.

stories.title: Update on The Wyatt Sicks Potential Signings with TNA Following WWE Exit
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling is reportedly showing serious interest in signing multiple former members of the WWE faction known as The Wyatt Sicks. Internal creative pitches are currently being discussed for Joe Gacy and Dexter Lumis ahead of upcoming television tapings. Although neither wrestler has officially signed a deal, their potential arrival follows their departures from WWE earlier this year.

stories.title: Lady Shani Suffers Eyelid Injury at AAA TripleMania 34
stories.tldr: AAA star Lady Shani suffered a nasty eyelid injury that required stitches during the opening match of Night One at AAA TripleMania 34 in Las Vegas. She was forced to leave the six-person tag team match after taking an unexpected shot to the face, prompting medical staff to halt the bout. Shani later shared a behind-the-scenes Instagram video documenting her day and revealing the extent of the cut, while reassuring fans that she is doing well and showing no concussion symptoms.

stories.title: TripleMania 34 Event Coverage and Post-Show Analysis
stories.tldr: TripleMania 34 delivered an action-packed two-night event across Paradise, Nevada, and Mexico City, showcasing major title changes, intense grudge matches, and an electric atmosphere driven by passionate fans. Night one featured Omos defeating Rey Mysterio, while night two highlighted El Grande Americano capturing the AAA Mega Championship and La Catalina ending Flammer's historic title reign. Post-show analysis points to fresh storylines and challengers across multiple divisions as the promotion looks toward future events.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling NOAH N-1 Victory Tournament Highlights and Results
stories.tldr: Pro Wrestling NOAH held recent N-1 Victory tournament events filled with notable tournament matches and emotional backstage developments. The tour was significantly impacted by the absence of hometown wrestler AMAKUSA, who was pulled from his scheduled GHC National Championship match against Naomichi Marufuji after medical testing revealed a neck abnormality. Despite the disappointment in Kumamoto, stars like Tetsuya Endo, Kaito Kiyomiya, and GHC Heavyweight Champion Tetsuya Naito rallied the locker room and fans to support AMAKUSA's eventual recovery and return.

stories.title: Elayna Black Discusses Her Transition to TNA Wrestling After Leaving WWE
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Elayna Black recently opened up about her transition to TNA Wrestling following her departure, crediting veteran Tommy Dreamer for helping guide her decision. Black also discussed how she intentionally played along with internet rumors about her retirement to protect the surprise of her debut on TNA's AMC premiere. Additionally, she reflected on the brutal physical toll of her bloody steel cage match against Xia Brookside for the Knockouts Championship at TNA Lockdown.

stories.title: CMLL Announces Tarde Mexicana Card Featuring Thunder Rosa and Zack Sabre Jr.
stories.tldr: CMLL has announced a special Tarde Mexicana card taking place on September 16 at Arena Mexico. The stacked lineup features Thunder Rosa defending the Mexican National Womens Championship against Dark Silueta just days before the promotion is set for its sold-out 93rd Anniversary event. Additionally, international star Zack Sabre Jr. will compete in a triangular classic wrestling match against Blue Panther and Xelhua as he prepares for his upcoming heavyweight title opportunity. The holiday event also boasts a high-profile tag team main event, an international six-man tag, a loaded womens tournament field, and an opening match.

stories.title: Go Shiozaki Cleared to Return for AJPW Odo Tournament
stories.tldr: Go Shiozaki has been medically cleared to return to All Japan Pro Wrestling following a recent hip injury that sidelined him from events in Kurobe and Matsumoto. He will make his comeback on September 16 in a six-man tag team match at Shin-Kiba 1stRING in Tokyo. The following night, Shiozaki will face Xyon in the second round of the Odo Tournament. Both upcoming consecutive cards feature stacked lineups, tournament matches, and specific broadcast details for fans.

stories.title: Hanan Set to Defend Wonder of Stardom Championship Against Ryuka
stories.tldr: Hanan is set to defend her Wonder of Stardom Championship against Ryuka at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo on September 29 during the Stardom Nighter in Korakuen 2026 Sep event. This will be Hanan's fourth defense of the white belt, while Ryuka challenges for the title for the first time after defeating the champion earlier this summer in the 5 Star Grand Prix. The rivalry intensified when Ryuka rejected Hanan's handshake and delivered a German suplex following a successful title defense by Hanan against Ami Sohrei.

stories.title: EMERGE Wrestling Announces Card Featuring NWA and TNA Stars
stories.tldr: EMERGE Wrestling is celebrating its milestone 100th event with EMERGE 100: Keep It 100 on Saturday, October 3, at the Bartholomew County Fairgrounds in Columbus, Indiana. The stacked card features top talent from both TNA Wrestling and the National Wrestling Alliance, including appearances by Trey Miguel, Pretty Boy Smooth, and Carson Drake. Fans can look forward to three major championship bouts, featuring Brayden Lee defending the World Championship against Lord Crewe, Tre LaMar defending the Outbreak Championship against TNA's Trey Miguel, and a chaotic four-team ladder match for the World Tag Team Championship.

stories.title: Spotlight on Cameraman Austin Cowen's Career Behind the Scenes
stories.tldr: After accidentally attending an EMERGE Wrestling event in 2017 while a student at Ball State University, Austin Cowen began a nine-year journey behind the lens as a roaming camera operator. Over the years, he transitioned from handling pre-shows to mastering the intricacies of wrestling psychology, framing, and event editing. Through his dedication, Cowen highlights the often-overlooked crew members whose behind-the-scenes work is essential for bringing independent wrestling to audiences beyond the live arena.

stories.title: Witnesses and Family Members Issue Statements Involving Yabo the Clown
stories.tldr: Scarlett Nyx has released additional statements from family members and witnesses supporting her abuse allegations against JCW wrestler Yabo the Clown, also known as Robert Stolzman III. These accounts from her father, twin sister, and an anonymous witness detail alleged physical violence, threats, and chaotic scenes at family events. While these claims remain unverified allegations rather than court findings, they significantly expand the scope of the controversy beyond a single accuser.

stories.title: Sirena Veil Wins NWA World Women's Television Title on Powerrr
stories.tldr: Sirena Veil captured the NWA World Women’s Television Championship by defeating Gisele Shaw on the September 12 episode of NWA Powerrr. The broadcast also confirmed that Shaw has officially signed a contract with the National Wrestling Alliance. Elsewhere on the card, Bryan Idol successfully defended his NWA National Championship in a three-way match against Mike Mondo and Slade, while King Trevor Murdoch the First led his Royal Court to victory in an eight-man Round Tables Match.

stories.title: Wrestling Daily Update: PAC, Steven Borden, and Big E
stories.tldr: The latest wrestling news update covers Sami Zayn reflecting on lobbying to bring PAC to Pro Wrestling Guerrilla, alongside extensive details from the newest Wrestling Observer Newsletter. The newsletter features major retrospectives on recently passed legends Bill Dundee and Andy Williams, as well as analyses of WWE, AEW, CMLL, and AAA. Additionally, various audio and video programs review recent events like TripleMania and discuss industry ratings, pay, and upcoming television broadcasts.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett Shares Details on Last-Minute RevPro Appearance
stories.tldr: During AEW All In weekend in London, WWE Hall of Famer Jeff Jarrett made a surprise appearance at a RevPro anniversary event that came together just hours before the show. After noticing the venue was located right next to his hotel, Jarrett ran into Will Ospreay and asked him to contact the promotion about checking out the event. RevPro promoter Andy Quildan quickly countered with an offer to wrestle, leading to Jarrett entering a championship gauntlet match.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling Historical Match Retrospective for September 16
stories.tldr: A historical look at September 16 in professional wrestling highlights the top ten matches of all time on this date based on Cagematch ratings and Wrestling Observer Newsletter star ratings. The number one spot goes to the classic 2006 Ring of Honor World Championship clash between Bryan Danielson and KENTA, which earned a stellar four and three-quarters star rating from Dave Meltzer. The list also features notable bouts from promotions like WWE, GCW, TNA, NJPW, wXw, and CMLL, showcasing legendary names such as CM Punk, John Cena, Nick Gage, and Will Ospreay. Meltzer famously praised the Danielson and KENTA encounter as an incredible journey and the best title match of that year, despite noting that Danielson focused more on elevating the championship itself than his challenger.

stories.title: Sherilyn Guerrero Discusses Carrying On Family Wrestling Legacy
stories.tldr: Sherilyn Guerrero is currently training for her professional wrestling debut, aiming to honor her family's legendary status while forging her own unique path. In a recent interview, she acknowledged the heavy expectations of her famous last name but emphasized that she intends to do things her own way. She also expressed gratitude toward her late father, Eddie Guerrero, for allowing her to experience a normal upbringing before entering the industry. Meanwhile, fellow second-generation star Dominik Mysterio has publicly offered his support as she embarks on this new journey.

stories.title: Retrospective Review of WCW Fall Brawl 1996 WarGames Match
stories.tldr: September 15 1996 marked the date of WCW Fall Brawl and its infamous main event WarGames match where Hollywood Hogan, Kevin Nash, nWo Sting, and Scott Hall defeated Arn Anderson, Lex Luger, Ric Flair, and Sting. A prominent industry reviewer delivered a scathing critique of the bout, heavily criticizing its nonsensical booking, massive plot holes, and total lack of logic. Issues ranged from the Four Horsemen failing to secure a fourth partner to confusing finishes, missing locker room support, and bizarre post-match segments. The chaotic event ultimately highlighted major structural flaws in WCW storytelling during the height of the nWo angle.

stories.title: Historical September 16 Professional Wrestling Title Changes Recapped
stories.tldr: September sixteenth stands out as one of the busiest historical days for professional wrestling title changes, featuring approximately 326 notable changes over the years. Major historical moments span decades, including Chris Jericho winning the Intercontinental Championship in 2002, Brock Lesnar capturing the WWE Title in 2003, and Becky Lynch claiming the SmackDown Women's Championship in 2018. The date has also seen memorable championship shifts across promotions like ECW, TNA, AAA, CMLL, and ROH.

stories.title: Nyla Rose speaks out on Oklahoma Athletic Commission controversy and AEW status
stories.tldr: Former AEW Women's World Champion Nyla Rose recently opened up about her ongoing absence from television, her past creative ideas, and her lingering frustrations regarding the Oklahoma State Athletic Commission. During an interview with Denise Salcedo, Rose did not mince words when labeling the commission as hateful bigots over their 2023 ruling against her competing in the state. She also expressed immense gratitude to AEW President Tony Khan for his immediate, unwavering public support during the controversy. Meanwhile, Rose remains under contract with AEW, keeping busy on the independent scene and working backstage while awaiting her next major television opportunity.

stories.title: AEW reported to have interest in free agent Dani Luna
stories.tldr: Former TNA Knockouts Tag Team Champion and NXT UK alumnus Dani Luna is reportedly on the radar of All Elite Wrestling, with backstage sources indicating she may have already signed or could be joining the promotion soon. Luna requested and was granted her release from TNA in March following a run that included challenging for the Knockouts title at Sacrifice. Since leaving TNA, she has maintained a busy schedule working on the independent scene and internationally for promotions like RevPro, wXw, Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling, and ATTACK!. Although speculation suggested she might debut during AEW's recent European tour, that appearance did not materialize, but her arrival in the promotion is still anticipated.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite card additions for September 16
stories.tldr: AEW has loaded up the card for the September 16 episode of Dynamite from Norfolk, Virginia, with several high-profile matches building toward All Out. Tony Khan recently announced two major additions, including a singles match between Jamie Hayter and Lena Kross ahead of their upcoming women's tag team title street fight. Additionally, a blockbuster eight-man tag team match has been booked featuring stars like Adam Copeland, Christian Cage, and FTR. The stacked lineup also features crucial preview bouts for upcoming pay-per-view championship clashes.

stories.title: AEW files trademark application for 'For The Sickos'
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling has filed a trademark application for the phrase For the Sickos, which has become a popular term for the promotion's most dedicated and hardcore fan base. AEW President Tony Khan has frequently embraced the nickname to describe his own deep passion for professional wrestling and love of great matches. The filing covers a wide range of merchandise such as shirts, T-shirts, and sweatshirts, alongside live wrestling events and television production. The company established the first-use date for the phrase as June 27, 2024, and the branding has already begun appearing on official merchandise collections.

stories.title: Pro wrestling rumor roundup
stories.tldr: TNA is reportedly expressing serious interest in bringing in multiple former members of The Wyatt Sicks following their surprising release from WWE earlier this year. Backstage executives on Raw were also said to be very impressed with Penta after his world heavyweight title match against Roman Reigns. Additionally, updates have emerged regarding Drew McIntyre missing in-ring action, MLW roster plans involving Masha Slamovich and Tessa Blanchard, an AEW trademark filing, and Natalya requesting to stay in NXT.

stories.title: William Regal calls AEW star best English wrestler since 1980s
stories.tldr: WWE Vice-President for Global Talent Development William Regal recently took to social media to heavily praise AEW star PAC. After bumping into PAC on a flight returning from Mexico, Regal declared him the best wrestler to come out of England since the 1980s. Regal highlighted PAC's unmatched aggression and credibility, setting him apart from other modern UK talents.

stories.title: AEW stars who could make a return at All Out
stories.tldr: Following Dr. Britt Baker D.M.D. making her return at AEW All In London 2026, anticipation is high for more major comebacks at AEW All Out 2026 in Chicago. Several prominent stars who have been sidelined by injuries, maternity leave, or outside projects are prime candidates to reappear. This list highlights seven absent talents, ranging from former world champions to returning tag teams, who could heavily shake up the promotion.

stories.title: Deonna Purrazzo reveals pitching Taya Valkyria for AEW faction
stories.tldr: Deonna Purrazzo recently discussed the short-lived AEW faction The Vendetta, which she formed with Taya Valkyria in late 2024 before they parted ways in early 2025. During a recent interview, Purrazzo shared several creative pitches she had for the group, including squash matches to showcase their dominance and a mobster-inspired feud with Anna Jay and Tay Conti. She also revealed plans to incorporate history involving Conti's past and pitched adding Gisele Shaw to expand the stable into a trios act.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland reflects on past bumps, injuries, and career inspirations
stories.tldr: In addition to his recent comments about his long-term knee injury, Swerve Strickland shared extensive career reflections during a new interview. He named Rey Mysterio, Adam Copeland, and Shawn Michaels as his primary inspirations, detailing how he studies tape with Michaels and gets advice from Copeland. Strickland also recounted a bizarre Lucha Underground concussion incident, named his most painful bump, and explained his performance philosophy of using stillness to control crowds.

stories.title: AEW signs broadcast deal with Hulu Japan
stories.tldr: Following competitor shifts in the region, All Elite Wrestling has announced its own major broadcasting partnership in Japan. Beginning this November, Hulu Japan will become the exclusive streaming home for Dynamite, Collision, and live pay-per-view events. The deal follows the expiration of AEW content on NJPW World earlier this year and coincides with Nippon TV's recent content agreements.

stories.title: AEW All Out 2026 officially sells out
stories.tldr: AEW All Out has officially sold out its current configuration with 9,148 tickets distributed more than a week ahead of the September 26 event at the NOW Arena. The pay-per-view has now surpassed the attendance figures of both the 2024 All Out and 2025 Worlds End events held at the same venue. AEW will face direct head-to-head competition in the Chicago market that night from a WWE and AAA Worlds Collide event featuring CM Punk in Rosemont. Meanwhile, match card updates reveal a blockbuster lineup featuring Will Ospreay defending the AEW World Championship against Jon Moxley, a three-way ladder match for the tag team titles, and a Chicago Street Fight.

stories.title: AEW roster pays tribute to Andy 'The Butcher' Williams
stories.tldr: Following the tragic passing of Andy The Butcher Williams at age 48, the wrestling industry continues to mourn the veteran star. AEW honored Williams during Saturday's Collision in Springfield, Massachusetts, where the entire roster gathered on stage for a moving video tribute. Mike Bailey reflected on the emotional moment on his vlog, describing it as a much-needed display of solidarity during a difficult week for the company. The live event also drew a solid crowd of 2,821 fans to the MassMutual Center.

stories.title: Discussions regarding drug testing policies in AEW
stories.tldr: Following Brian Cage's open admission to past performance-enhancing drug use, scrutiny has intensified regarding AEW's wellness and drug-testing policies. Industry reports revealed that no active or former personnel have ever confirmed undergoing drug testing within the company. While external critics have baselessly accused AEW of allowing steroid abuse, insiders note that rampant PED use remains a broader issue across the entire professional wrestling landscape.

stories.title: Matt Jackson discusses Kenny Omega post-AEW All In
stories.tldr: Following Will Ospreay's historic AEW World Championship victory over Kenny Omega at AEW All In, Matt Jackson has shared his perspective on the marquee match. Speaking on a recent Being The Elite voiceover, Jackson praised the classic encounter from his unique ringside vantage point. He also assured fans that Omega's career is far from finished as the former champion heals up and prepares to return stronger.

stories.title: Sami Zayn responds to critics and addresses second WWE Championship reign
stories.tldr: Newly crowned two-time Undisputed WWE Champion Sami Zayn recently addressed critics questioning his physical appearance, explaining that connecting with fans matters more than having a traditional jacked physique. During a media appearance, Zayn also discussed how his second championship reign differs from his short-lived first run, shared his candid thoughts on rival CM Punk, and reacted to reports of a potential clash with Roman Reigns. Additionally, backstage plans suggest this title switch is designed to set up a massive champion versus champion showdown at WWE Crown Jewel in Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: WWE NXT episode previews, reviews, and card updates
stories.tldr: Recent episodes of WWE NXT on The CW delivered major fallout from the Performance Center, highlighted by the revival of the cross brand Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic featuring talent from NXT, Raw, and SmackDown. The show featured high stakes action including a triple threat match for an NXT Championship opportunity and the ongoing chaotic rivalry between Myles Borne and Tavion Heights. Additionally, newly crowned AAA Reina de Reinas Champion La Catalina made a surprise appearance to confront NXT Women Champion Kelani Jordan, setting up a stacked card for the upcoming September 22 episode.

stories.title: WWE NXT announces return of Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic
stories.tldr: The Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic is officially returning to NXT with a major cross-brand twist, featuring fourteen teams from NXT, Raw, SmackDown, EVOLVE, and AAA. NXT General Manager Robert Stone announced the tournament on the September 15 episode, confirming that action will kick off on September 22 with the first opening round matches. The Creed Brothers are already confirmed for the field, while full brackets are set to be revealed on social media later this week.

stories.title: Janel Grant makes public appearance and discusses injuries and Vince McMahon lawsuit
stories.tldr: Janel Grant made her first public appearance since her federal lawsuit against Vince McMahon and WWE was moved to private arbitration, accepting an advocacy award from the Connecticut Alliance to End Sexual Violence. During her speech and subsequent social media posts, she revealed she nearly died following a severe accidental fall in her home that left her with a concussion, broken ribs, and a lung hemorrhage. Grant candidly discussed how years of living under a restrictive nondisclosure agreement and battling severe isolation nearly destroyed her life, but she expressed deep gratitude for the support system that ultimately saved her.

stories.title: Mason Rook becomes top contender for NXT Championship
stories.tldr: Mason Rook secured a future match against NXT Champion Grayson Waller by winning a chaotic Triple Threat main event on WWE NXT. Rook defeated Tony D'Angelo and Saquon Shugars after surviving heavy interference and high-impact action. The match was earned the previous week when the trio won a six-man tag team match. Waller confronted the new number one contender to close out the show, setting the stage for their upcoming championship match.

stories.title: Roxanne Perez urges fans to respect wrestlers' personal boundaries
stories.tldr: WWE superstar Roxanne Perez recently spoke out about the importance of wrestling fans respecting the personal boundaries of performers outside of official events. Drawing from her own childhood experiences as a fan, Perez emphasized that she deeply appreciates her supporters and loves meeting them at arenas and designated locations. However, she stressed that hotels and airports must be respected as private spaces where talent is simply trying to travel and live their lives as human beings. She concluded that needing privacy and occasionally turning fans down on the road does not mean performers are ungrateful for their fanbase.

stories.title: Myles Borne turns heel on Tavion Heights on NXT
stories.tldr: Myles Borne lured Tavion Heights into a false sense of security on the September 15 episode of WWE NXT by offering a seemingly heartfelt apology for his previous betrayal at Heatwave. After Heights finally accepted his apology and the two embraced, Borne brutally attacked him, throwing him through the barricade and smashing his leg with a steel chair. The vicious ambush cemented Borne's definitive heel turn and proved his earlier remorse was nothing more than a calculated setup.

stories.title: CM Punk details ongoing vertigo issue from 2002 head injury
stories.tldr: CM Punk recently revealed on Netflix that a severe skull fracture he suffered in June 2002 still causes him recurring bouts of vertigo over two decades later. He explained that the trauma rattled the equilibrium-controlling bones in his inner ear, occasionally causing the world to spin when he lies flat. Punk admitted he has wrestled through numerous matches unaware of his surroundings while experiencing these episodes and humorously blamed the condition for his famously crooked moonsault against Cody Rhodes.

stories.title: La Catalina debuts on WWE NXT and targets Kelani Jordan
stories.tldr: During the September 15 edition of WWE NXT, NXT Women’s Champion Kelani Jordan boasted about her dominant reign and claimed no viable challengers remained to step up to her. Newly crowned AAA Reina de Reinas Champion La Catalina made a surprise appearance to interrupt Jordan, quickly followed by NXT Women’s North American Champion ZARIA and Thea Hail. The segment erupted into a chaotic four-way brawl that left Catalina and Hail standing tall in the ring after getting the better of Jordan and ZARIA.

stories.title: WWE Raw global viewership metrics on Netflix
stories.tldr: WWE Raw returned to Netflix's global top ten for the week of September 7 through September 13, finishing seventh with 2.6 million views and 4.5 million hours viewed. The September 7 episode bounced back after a previous taped show missed the rankings entirely, performing above its recent nine-week global average. Netflix calculates these metrics by dividing total hours watched by program runtime, following positive executive feedback regarding the platform's ten-year, five billion dollar partnership with TKO.

stories.title: Paul Wight recalls moment he knew his WWE run was ending
stories.tldr: Paul Wight recently revealed on TMZ Sports Inside The Ring that a single word from Vince McMahon signaled the end of his active in-ring career in WWE. During the COVID era and around the time of his angle with Randy Orton, McMahon referred to him as Paul instead of his longtime moniker Show or Big Show. Recognizing that management now viewed him primarily for ambassadorial and non-wrestling roles rather than as an active competitor, Wight ultimately chose to leave the company in 2021. Seeking to continue his in-ring career, he signed with Tony Khan and joined AEW, despite acknowledging his extensive injury history and physical struggles in recent years.

stories.title: Netflix removes WWE Superstar custom profile icons
stories.tldr: Netflix has quietly removed custom WWE Superstar profile icons that were introduced in early 2025 to celebrate the arrival of WWE Raw on the streaming platform. Users who previously selected avatars featuring legends and stars like John Cena, CM Punk, Rhea Ripley, and Rey Mysterio found their profiles automatically reverted to standard options without any official explanation. Fans quickly took to social media to voice their frustration over the disappearance of the avatars, especially since even actively equipped icons were wiped. While WWE programming continues to stream as usual, it remains unknown if Netflix plans to roll out an updated collection or keep the icons permanently removed.

stories.title: Joe Hendry and historic WWE musical releases
stories.tldr: Joe Hendry is set to release his first album under WWE Music titled Beyond Belief on October 5, featuring eleven tracks like Give Joe Hendry Every Single Belt and Fire Logan Paul. This musical endeavor follows a rich history of WWE superstars venturing into the recording booth, from Michael Hayes and Lilian Garcia to John Cena and R-Truth. Over the decades, various compilation albums, solo projects, and crossover records have bridged the gap between professional wrestling and the music industry. Hendry now joins this long lineage of talent as anticipation builds for his upcoming release.

stories.title: Kelani Jordan reflects on toughest wrestling moments
stories.tldr: WWE NXT Women's Champion Kelani Jordan recently opened up about the most challenging period of her career during an interview with Denise Salcedo. Reflecting on the time between her championship reigns, Jordan admitted she struggled with finding her character's identity and shedding her initial happy-to-be-here persona. This transitional phase forced her to develop the killer instinct and grit needed to evolve on a higher level. Today, that growth is reflected in her more aggressive attitude and recent success on both NXT and Monday Night Raw.

stories.title: WWE backstage reaction to Usos' comment about Andrade
stories.tldr: Andrade recently criticized WWE for a perceived double standard where certain wrestlers receive endless opportunities to become stars while Mexican talent struggles for the same chances. In response, The Usos posted a fiery tweet declaring that they draw money, sparking a massive social media debate over race and opportunity. However, backstage reports revealed that the locker room largely viewed the tweet as typical family pride rather than a targeted racial jab. Ultimately, while fans turned the exchange into a major controversy, WWE personnel inside the company reportedly paid it very little attention.

stories.title: Kendal Grey gives update on WWE NXT absence
stories.tldr: Kendal Grey provided a disappointing health update indicating that she is still not cleared to return to WWE NXT. The former champion has been sidelined with vertigo since suffering head trauma during her title defense against Kelani Jordan at NXT Heatwave on August 30. While concussions were ruled out, her vestibular issues continue to keep her out of action indefinitely. Meanwhile, her ally Wren Sinclair has been suspended for attacking Jordan and a referee, leaving both wrestlers off television for the foreseeable future.

stories.title: Layla discusses wrestling retirement and launching LayTalk
stories.tldr: Former WWE Women and Divas Champion Layla recently opened up about why she completely vanished from the wrestling world after her retirement, admitting she lost her identity and needed to step away for her own well-being. Although her sudden departure strained some relationships with former peers, she insists the drastic step was necessary for her personal growth. Now, approaching the 20th anniversary of her 2006 WWE Diva Search victory, Layla is stepping back into the spotlight to launch a new podcast called LayTalk. The upcoming show aims to celebrate the women of the Divas Era, share untold backstage stories, and feature nostalgic reunions, starting with her longtime friend and former colleague Kelly Kelly.

stories.title: Shotzi discusses support from Charlotte Flair and Bayley after WWE release
stories.tldr: Following her recent release from WWE, professional wrestler Shotzi opened up about the overwhelming support she received from locker room leaders Charlotte Flair and Bayley during a difficult transition. Shotzi highlighted how Flair immediately offered professional and personal assistance, noting their deep bond formed while recovering from ACL injuries together. She also praised Bayley for organizing a special gathering in Orlando to bring the local wrestling community together during her dark times. Ultimately, Shotzi emphasized that the genuine relationships and mentorship she gained in WWE remain far more valuable to her than any in-ring accolades.

stories.title: F4W Daily Update coverage
stories.tldr: The latest daily wrestling update covers extensive commentary on WWE and AEW storylines, including Sami Zayn discussing CM Punk and potential matches against Roman Reigns. Major updates highlight talent appearances, media projects, recent injury announcements on the independent circuit, and upcoming event bookings. Additionally, promotions like Produce have announced major talent rosters for their upcoming shows in Brooklyn and Los Angeles.

stories.title: Blake Monroe expresses confidence in WWE main roster future
stories.tldr: Rising WWE talent Blake Monroe recently expressed supreme confidence in her future during an interview with Denise Salcedo, boldly stating that the main roster is not ready for her. She also shared valuable mentorship she has received from established stars, highlighting specific guidance from Natalya. This encouragement has reinforced Monroe's patient yet driven approach as she continues to climb the ranks in the company.

stories.title: The true cost of being a WWE fan in 2026
stories.tldr: Gone are the days of the unified nine dollar and ninety nine cent WWE Network subscription, replaced in 2026 by a heavily fractured media landscape. US fans now require a patchwork of separate services like Netflix, cable, ESPN Unlimited, and Peacock just to watch all of the weekly programming and Premium Live Events. Furthermore, hardcore fans face an additional annual fee for Club WWE to access exclusive house show matches and voting privileges. While most viewers already subscribe to some of these general entertainment platforms, the overall cost and effort to consume complete WWE content has risen significantly.

stories.title: Drew McIntyre WWE return plans update
stories.tldr: Drew McIntyre has been absent from WWE television for five months since his match against Jacob Fatu at WrestleMania 42, leaving fans wondering about his eventual comeback. Having previously held the Undisputed WWE Championship just a month before his disappearance, he returns to a dramatically shifted landscape with multiple high-profile creative directions. Potential plans for his return include a fresh rivalry with Seth Rollins, chasing the Undisputed WWE Title against rivals like Sami Zayn and CM Punk, or inserting himself into the ongoing war against The Bloodline.

stories.title: Lex Luger reveals WWE Hall of Fame plans changed after fall
stories.tldr: Lex Luger recently revealed that a scary fall at the Atlanta airport just one day before his 2025 WWE Hall of Fame induction forced him to alter his entrance plans. Instead of walking a significant distance to the podium as originally intended, he was limited to rising from his wheelchair to take several assisted steps. During the same interview, Luger also discussed his iconic Torture Rack finishing move, reflecting on why he never attempted it on Yokozuna and explaining how hoisting up The Giant in WCW was surprisingly manageable due to his height.

stories.title: Lil Yachty discusses WWE involvement, contract, and physical toll
stories.tldr: Rapper Lil Yachty revealed that he signed an official contract with WWE after initially coming in to manage Trick Williams. Addressing fan criticism, Yachty denied that his presence or salary has anything to do with roster cuts like Ilja Dragunov's departure, noting that he actually loses money doing the gig. He also reflected on the intense physical toll of his match against Baron Corbin and the organic origin of the Gingerbread Man storyline.

stories.title: Roman Reigns praised for match against Penta on WWE Raw in Mexico
stories.tldr: Following his successful title defense against Penta in Mexico City, Roman Reigns has earned high praise from WWE executive William Regal, who called his performance masterful. The match generated massive social media engagement and reinforced backstage belief that Penta is a long-term main event star for the company. Meanwhile, Reigns is already moving on to his next challenger, as a post-match attack from LA Knight has set up a World Heavyweight Championship match at Money in the Bank.

stories.title: Fred Ottman (Typhoon) released from hospital following health scare
stories.tldr: Fred Ottman, widely known as Typhoon and Tugboat, has been released from the hospital following a recent emergency room visit and health scare. In a new video update, the WWE Hall of Famer shared that while he is feeling better and recovering at home, his primary and orthopedic doctors are still investigating the underlying cause of the issue. Ottman displayed noticeable arm bruising and reflected on what has been a difficult year following previous major medical emergencies, thanking fans for their continued prayers and support.

stories.title: Stephanie Vaquer reveals surgery during WWE absence
stories.tldr: Newly crowned WWE Women's World Champion Stephanie Vaquer has revealed that she underwent surgery during her recent four-month absence from the ring. She recently won the title back from Liv Morgan in Santiago, Chile, following a recovery period that she described as one of the hardest experiences of her life. Although she did not disclose the exact nature of the procedure, reports previously noted she dealt with shoulder and ankle issues following WrestleMania. Vaquer stated that stepping back into the ring felt like coming back to life and that she has returned better than ever.

stories.title: Roman Reigns vs. LA Knight official for WWE Money in the Bank 2026
stories.tldr: Following their post-show confrontation on Raw, Roman Reigns and LA Knight are now officially locked in to headline WWE Money in the Bank 2026. Raw General Manager Adam Pearce confirmed that Reigns will defend the World Heavyweight Championship against Knight on October 10 in New Orleans. The premium live event will stream live at 6 p.m. Eastern on the ESPN app in the United States and Netflix internationally from the Smoothie King Center.

stories.title: MVP praises Zilla Fatu and predicts bright WWE future
stories.tldr: AEW star MVP recently drew parallels between his own youth and Zilla Fatu's past incarceration, offering strong support for the rising WWE prospect. Speaking on his podcast, MVP predicted that Fatu will be a fixture in the company for years to come. While noting the immense pressure and hard work required to succeed in NXT and on the main roster, MVP believes Fatu has the talent and family backing to thrive.

stories.title: Joe Gacy discusses post-WWE plans and Wyatt Sicks
stories.tldr: Joe Gacy is thriving on the independent circuit following his WWE departure, maintaining a busier schedule than he has experienced in years. He recently detailed upcoming independent bookings that will reunite various members of the Wyatt Sicks for tag team action. While Bo Dallas's future remains uncertain to him, Gacy hopes the entire stable can eventually share a ring together again.

stories.title: Xelina Vega reflects on her WWE exit
stories.tldr: Following her recent emotional reflections on her family history, Xelina Vega is opening up about the creative freedom she expects in her post-WWE career. The former star stated she is ready to shed corporate restrictions and showcase a more authentic version of herself to fans. Despite the circumstances of her release alongside her husband, she remains grateful for her decade-long tenure and the defining moments she experienced. She is now looking forward to executing ideas and pitches that were previously blocked during her time with the company.

stories.title: The Bloodline WWE feud build and analysis
stories.tldr: The feud between The Bloodline and the 946 faction has escalated dangerously after 946 set their rivals vehicle on fire and ramped up psychological warfare on television. Tensions within The Bloodline, particularly between Jey Uso and Jacob Fatu, threaten to boil over ahead of a potential WarGames clash at Survivor Series. Meanwhile, Roman Reigns is set to defend his title against LA Knight, with the fiery rivalry potentially stretching deep into the future.

stories.title: Details on pay cuts offered to former WWE stars
stories.tldr: TKO has shifted its WWE contract strategy to heavily reward top stars while aggressively cutting pay for veterans and older talent. Specific figures have emerged revealing that acts like The New Day and Ridge Holland faced massive pay reductions exceeding fifty percent before leaving the company. Meanwhile, at least one unnamed major star accepted a fifty percent cut, and talent continuing their careers elsewhere are beginning to surface in competing promotions.

stories.title: WWE Men's Money in the Bank 2026 qualifying details
stories.tldr: Following Je'Von Evans and Bron Breakker securing their spots, attention turns to who will round out the six-person Men's Money in the Bank ladder match. Analysts are eyeing top names like returning star Seth Rollins, rising powerhouse Oba Femi, and SmackDown rivals Finn Balor and GUNTHER as potential next qualifiers. The final field will collide in New Orleans on October 10.

stories.title: Rey Mysterio responds to Dominik Mysterio's demands
stories.tldr: Rey Mysterio has responded to Dominik Mysterio's demands for an apology and his legendary mask to finally end their bitter family feud. In a recent interview, Rey dismissed his son's threats and suggested Dominik is severely underestimating him. Rey also criticized Dominik for having an easier path into the wrestling industry compared to his own hard-fought beginnings at age fourteen.

stories.title: Bryan Alvarez WWE Raw report for September 14
stories.tldr: Subscribers can now access the complete and detailed breakdown of the September 14 episode of Raw. The full report delivers comprehensive analysis on the matches and segments that shaped the broadcast. Fans looking for an exhaustive review of the night can read the complete subscriber exclusive right now.

stories.title: AJ Lee discusses the current WWE women's locker room
stories.tldr: Former WWE star AJ Lee recently revealed that she hid her bipolar diagnosis throughout her wrestling career while managing intense emotional struggles on the road. Expanding on those reflections, she also contrasted the cutthroat Divas era she worked in with the supportive sisterhood of the modern WWE women's locker room. Lee noted that her generation's efforts helped create a larger feast of opportunities for female performers today instead of forcing them to fight over a single spot.

stories.title: Jeff Cobb shares insights from his WWE run
stories.tldr: Following his departure from WWE and return to New Japan Pro Wrestling, Jeff Cobb has shared insights from his brief tenure as JC Mateo, including surprising encounters with NJPW fans in Saudi Arabia. Cobb discussed the intense nature of WWE fan interactions, such as supporters waiting at airport baggage claims during early morning hours, which ultimately gave him a deeper appreciation for their passion. Now aligned with the Unbound Co. stable, Cobb is focused on chasing championship gold and preparing for his upcoming match at Destruction in Kobe.

stories.title: Gail Kim legal dispute update with TNA parent company Anthem
stories.tldr: A new development has emerged in the ongoing legal dispute between TNA parent company Anthem Wrestling Exhibitions and Hall of Famer Gail Kim, with a Nashville Chancery Court status conference now scheduled for November 20. The legal battle began in January after Kim indicated she had potential claims under the Florida Private Whistleblower Act following her departure during a company restructuring in March 2025. Anthem is seeking a court declaration that Kim was an independent contractor governed by Tennessee law, which would block her from pursuing claims under Florida laws or Title VII. Although the parties previously entered mediation on June 24, no official resolution has been announced.

stories.title: Bryan & Vinny Show reviews 1984 Mid-South Wrestling
stories.tldr: The latest edition of the audio show delivers an unexpectedly chaotic episode due to a massive YouTube computer crash that knocked the video stream into oblivion. Despite the technical difficulties, the hosts continued recording their audio uninterrupted so fans do not miss a thing. Listeners can still enjoy the full experience featuring Granny, classic Mid-South wrestling coverage from November 17, 1984, trivia, and more. It proves to be another fun and unpredictable installment that is available now for download.

stories.title: Referee Christopher Parkman hit in face with chair
stories.tldr: Independent wrestling referee Christopher Parkman, known as Big C, took a brutal and unprotected folding chair shot directly to the face during a production for the YouTube-based GTS Wrestling. The viral video sparked widespread concern among fans and veterans alike, including former WWE and TNA star Gail Kim, who criticized the spot due to modern concerns over brain trauma. Despite the backlash and the dangerous nature of the blow reminiscent of the Attitude Era, Parkman embraced the moment on social media by calling it the best chair shot he has ever taken.

stories.title: Rob Van Dam reflects on fatherhood and modern wrestling
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Rob Van Dam recently opened up about how becoming a father has fundamentally shifted his life priorities and given him a profound new sense of responsibility. During a recent interview, he also shared his candid perspective on the modern wrestling landscape alongside fellow legend Kurt Angle. While he deeply admires the incredible athleticism and gymnastic skills of today's talent, he expressed concern over the overuse of signature moves and wrestlers rushing through their matches. Ultimately, RVD noted that constantly repeating iconic maneuvers diminishes their special impact, even if it still gets a reaction from the live crowd.

stories.title: WON Flashback: Eric Bischoff fires Steve Austin from WCW in 1995
stories.tldr: On September 15 1995, Eric Bischoff made one of the biggest blunders in wrestling history by firing a 30 year old Steve Austin from World Championship Wrestling. At the time, Austin was sidelined with a torn tricep suffered on a New Japan tour, frustrated with his creative stagnation, and caught in the crossfire of backstage politics dominated by the Hogan and Flair cliques. While no one could have predicted his eventual legendary megastardom as Stone Cold in the World Wrestling Federation, his unceremonious firing while injured remains a legendary historical misstep.

stories.title: Historical wrestling title changes on September 15
stories.tldr: September 15 stands out as one of the busiest days in professional wrestling history, boasting 301 notable title changes according to wrestlingdata.com archives spanning decades. Major historical milestones on this date include iconic championship victories by Curt Hennig, Jacqueline, Daniel Bryan, and Taya Valkyrie across various major promotions. The timeline of historic September 15 events ranges from early victories in 1988 up to notable bouts projected into 2025.

stories.title: Top 10 pro wrestling matches in history for September 15
stories.tldr: This article highlights the top ten professional wrestling matches in history that took place on September 15, based on Cagematch ratings and Wrestling Observer Newsletter star ratings. The ranked list spans multiple legendary promotions including Ring of Honor, New Japan Pro Wrestling, and Pro Wrestling Guerrilla. A standout entry details the 2018 clash between Kenny Omega and Tomohiro Ishii, which received high praise from Dave Meltzer despite tough tournament comparisons. Fans can explore the complete historical rankings and read detailed insights into these classic encounters.

stories.title: AAA Worlds Collide and TripleMania coverage
stories.tldr: Allstate Arena has advertised a loaded card for the upcoming AAA Worlds Collide event on September 26, featuring top WWE names like CM Punk. Meanwhile, recent TripleMania 34 YouTube metrics highlight massive viewership driven heavily by the El Grande Americano and Dominik Mysterio rivalry. Behind the scenes, Omos revealed that The Undertaker is acting as the primary booker and promoter for the promotion.

stories.title: TNA Wrestling expressing serious interest in former Wyatt Sicks members
stories.tldr: Following their recent WWE departures, multiple members of the Wyatt Sicks are reportedly on TNA Wrestling's radar. TNA has expressed serious interest in bringing in some of the former faction members, though no official deals have been finalized yet. These potential acquisitions could significantly bolster the promotion's tag team division as it builds toward upcoming major events.

stories.title: Mustafa Ali discusses TNA appeal and recruiting role
stories.tldr: Mustafa Ali recently shed light on what makes TNA an attractive destination for wrestlers and addressed rumors about his backstage responsibilities. Speaking in a recent interview, he highlighted the promotion's creative freedom, recent growth, and upcoming move to AMC as major draws for talent. He also clarified that despite frequently recommending independent wrestlers to the company, he does not hold an official scouting or recruiting title.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov expected to sign with AEW following WWE departure
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Ilja Dragunov is expected to sign with All Elite Wrestling following his departure from the company when his contract expired in August. Although an official deal is still being finalized due to administrative and visa hurdles, the move has been widely anticipated. Meanwhile, AEW roster members like Kyle Fletcher have expressed public excitement about the impending arrival, sparking online discussions about his potential future feuds.

stories.title: AEW announces start date and location for 2026 Continental Classic
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling has officially announced the start date and location for the fourth annual Continental Classic tournament, which will kick off on Wednesday, November 18, 2026. The opening night of the round-robin tournament will take place live on AEW Dynamite from the Mission Ballroom in Denver, Colorado, marking the earliest start date in the tournament's history. Tickets for the event go on sale to the general public on Monday, September 21, as the promotion follows up on the Full Gear pay-per-view held in Phoenix, Arizona.

stories.title: Mercedes Martinez provides update on ACL surgery and recovery fundraiser
stories.tldr: Former ROH Women’s World Champion Mercedes Martinez has confirmed her ACL surgery is scheduled for October 15 after raising enough money for the initial deposit through a GoFundMe campaign. Martinez suffered the torn ACL during an August match against Allie Katch, which tragically cut short her planned retirement tour that was meant to run through the end of 2026. While she has cleared her first financial hurdle, her fundraiser is still short of its $25,000 overall goal needed to fully cover the procedure and subsequent rehabilitation. Despite the abrupt end to her two-decade in-ring career, Martinez hopes to transition into a backstage role in wrestling once she recovers.

stories.title: Brian Cage compares Cody Rhodes vs. Roman Reigns to Bryan Danielson vs. Will Ospreay
stories.tldr: AEW star Brian Cage is defending his controversial 2024 social media claim that Bryan Danielson versus Will Ospreay was vastly superior to Cody Rhodes versus Roman Reigns at WrestleMania 40. Although Cage acknowledged that the WrestleMania main event was an awesome and fun sports entertainment spectacle, he argued that bell-to-bell it could not compete with the AEW match. Despite facing heavy backlash from WWE fans at the time, Cage felt fully justified when outlets later named Danielson and Ospreay their match of the year.

stories.title: Willow Nightingale names AEW wrestlers who bring out her best
stories.tldr: Willow Nightingale recently named the fellow wrestlers who push her to new heights, including Kris Statlander, Harley Cameron, and Athena, while also expressing a future desire to face Megan Bayne. Recorded ahead of All In, the interview highlighted her strong bonds and fierce rivalries within the locker room. In addition to her comments on her peers, recent reports indicate she will continue making television appearances while recovering from a broken hand.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher makes bold prediction about his pro wrestling future
stories.tldr: Australian professional wrestler Kyle Fletcher recently made a bold prediction about his career during an interview with Catch Club. The 27-year-old proclaimed himself to be the definitive future of the professional wrestling industry. Although the interview was recorded prior to AEW All In and referenced his past reign as International Champion, Fletcher emphasized that his current accomplishments are only the beginning of a decades-long run at the top.

stories.title: Orange Cassidy reveals his pick for greatest pro wrestler of all time
stories.tldr: AEW star Orange Cassidy recently revealed his dream wrestling partners and opponents during an interview leading up to AEW All In. He selected technical wrestling legend Dean Malenko as his ideal tag team partner because Malenko knows thousands of moves and could handle the workload while Cassidy hangs out. For his dream opponent, Cassidy named Kenny Omega, whom he also boldly declared to be the greatest professional wrestler of all time.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite viewership sees drop on September 9, 2026
stories.tldr: AEW Dynamite experienced a significant viewership drop on its September 9, 2026 episode, pulling in 571,000 viewers and a 0.1 demo rating on TBS. This represents a steep decline from the previous week's numbers and a minor decrease compared to the same week in 2025. These figures account strictly for linear television and exclude any digital or streaming audiences. Coverage will continue as the promotion builds toward its next major live event.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland names his three biggest professional wrestling influences
stories.tldr: Swerve Strickland recently revealed that Rey Mysterio, Adam Copeland, and Shawn Michaels served as his three biggest professional wrestling influences while growing up. He has successfully interacted, worked, or received direct mentorship from all three legends throughout his career. Additionally, Strickland discussed his new AEW trio alongside Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed. He explained how securing the rights to the song New Level breathes fresh energy into both the performers and the music itself.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland releases new music single 'Coo Coo'
stories.tldr: AEW star Swerve Strickland has teamed up with influential Harlem artist Max B for a new single titled Coo Coo, set for release on September 14. This high-profile collaboration serves as the second release under Strickland's upcoming record label imprint with attorney Tony C. Richa. Strickland continues to solidify his status as a legitimate crossover hip-hop artist while maintaining his dominant presence in professional wrestling.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland reveals he worked years through torn meniscus prior to surgery
stories.tldr: AEW star Swerve Strickland revealed that he wrestled for roughly five years with a torn meniscus that he originally suffered in 2019. Despite the significant injury, he continued performing without interruption until he finally underwent surgery earlier in 2026 once he felt comfortable taking a break to heal. During a recent media appearance, he also discussed his holistic approach to managing the physical toll of professional wrestling by relying on heat, ice, and rest while avoiding medication whenever possible.

stories.title: Tyler Breeze reveals openness to working with AEW following WWE deal expiration
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Tyler Breeze recently discussed the expiration of his unique WWE agreement on The Certified Mark Show, noting that it previously allowed him unusual flexibility with independent and third-party projects. With that deal officially ending in August, Breeze stated that his previous broadcasting restrictions have been lifted. He is now completely open to exploring new wrestling opportunities outside of WWE, specifically naming promotions like AEW and Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling. Breeze emphasized that he is not done with the wrestling business and is ready to accept offers from any major television company.

stories.title: Brian Cage discusses his status, steroid/TRT use, and Tessa Blanchard
stories.tldr: AEW star Brian Cage recently addressed his career frustrations and candidly discussed his history with steroids and TRT. In the same interview, Cage also offered high praise for Tessa Blanchard, predicting that the talented star will soon find her way to a national stage in either AEW or WWE. He emphasized the distinction between responsible hormone replacement therapy and abuse, while championing Blanchard's in-ring abilities.

stories.title: Brian Cage expresses strong desire to turn babyface in AEW
stories.tldr: AEW veteran Brian Cage recently addressed his frustrations regarding his utilization and false accusations surrounding PED use in the company. Expanding on those recent interviews, the longtime powerhouse has now revealed that he is tired of playing a heel and desperately wants to transition into a babyface role. Cage believes that keeping his current presentation and established music will make his eventual babyface turn resonate even stronger with the fans.

stories.title: Kevin Knight reflects on AEW TNT Title reign and loss
stories.tldr: Former TNT Champion Kevin Knight recently opened up about dropping his title to Darby Allin at AEW All In after a 140-day reign. Speaking on the Battleground Podcast, Knight asserted that the loss did not hurt his momentum because Allin needed outside interference from Sting and Steven Borden to put him away. He believes this chaotic finish proved his dominance and put the entire locker room on notice.

stories.title: Orange Cassidy details pre-match preparation and dream AEW tag partner
stories.tldr: AEW star Orange Cassidy has famously inspired fans with his relaxed attitude, proving that his laid-back persona resonates outside the ring. Elaborating on that mindset, Cassidy recently revealed his minimalist pre-match routine, which consists of plenty of sleep, light stretching, and listening to Dua Lipa. He also named wrestling legend Dean Malenko as his dream tag team partner so that Malenko can handle the physical work while Cassidy relaxes.

stories.title: LA Knight attacks Roman Reigns after Raw, setting up Money in the Bank title match
stories.tldr: Following a grueling World Heavyweight Championship defense against Penta on the September 14, 2026 episode of Raw in Mexico City, Roman Reigns was confronted and attacked by LA Knight after the show went off the air. Knight laid out the champion with a BFT and posed with the title, prompting an irate Reigns to issue an NSFW social media promo accepting a title match against him. The bout is now officially set for Money in the Bank on October 10 in New Orleans. Meanwhile, early ladder match qualifiers are underway, and future reports suggest a massive champion versus champion match at Crown Jewel could await the winner.

stories.title: Lola Vice qualifies for Money in the Bank in WWE main roster debut on RAW
stories.tldr: Lola Vice made her main roster debut on the September 14 episode of WWE Raw in Mexico City by competing in a triple-threat Money in the Bank qualifying match. She defeated WWE Women's Intercontinental Champion Raquel Rodriguez and NXT Women's Champion Kelani Jordan by pinning Rodriguez with a roll-up. The victory secured Vice's spot in the 2026 Women's Money in the Bank ladder match, making her the second woman to qualify following Sol Ruca. WWE Chief Content Officer Triple H later publicly endorsed Vice's breakout performance on social media.

stories.title: Je'Von Evans qualifies for Men's Money in the Bank match on WWE RAW
stories.tldr: Je'Von Evans has officially qualified for the Men's Money in the Bank ladder match after winning a chaotic triple threat match on WWE Raw in Mexico City. Evans defeated both Austin Theory and Big Cass, overcoming significant power disadvantages to secure the pinfall victory with the OG Cutter. He now joins Bron Breakker as the second confirmed participant in the men's ladder match scheduled for October 10 in New Orleans. Lola Vice also qualified for the women's ladder match during the same episode by defeating Raquel Rodriguez and Kelani Jordan.

stories.title: Sam Adonis spotted backstage at WWE RAW in Mexico City
stories.tldr: Independent wrestler and former AAA star Sam Adonis was spotted backstage at Monday's WWE Raw event at Arena CDMX in Mexico City. Adonis, who is the brother of WWE commentator Corey Graves, has deep ties to the Mexican wrestling scene and spent years competing in the country before WWE acquired AAA in 2025. He shared a lighthearted photo with his brother on social media, joking about his high level of local popularity, and thanked WWE management for making him feel welcome. Currently, there are no indications that his backstage visit is tied to a potential WWE contract or upcoming in-ring appearance.

stories.title: Chad Gable defeats Dragon Lee to retain Intercontinental Title on WWE RAW
stories.tldr: Chad Gable successfully defended his Intercontinental Championship against Dragon Lee on WWE Raw in Mexico City in a critically acclaimed technical showcase. The hard-fought battle featured incredible counters, near-falls from moves like Operation Dragon and the Styles Clash, and a decisive ankle lock submission in the center of the ring. Fans in attendance rewarded the action with loud chants of this is wrestling, while social media praised the bout as a match of the year contender. Following the victory, Gable showed respect to Lee by raising his hand, marking his second successful title defense since winning the belt at SummerSlam.

stories.title: WWE announces upcoming Money in the Bank qualifying matches for RAW
stories.tldr: WWE has announced that the September 21 episode of Monday Night Raw in San Antonio, Texas, will feature additional qualifying matches for the upcoming Money in the Bank ladder matches. Four superstars have already punched their tickets to the premium live event, with Bron Breakker and Je'Von Evans securing spots in the men's match, and Sol Ruca and Lola Vice qualifying for the women's match. Evans and Vice earned their places during the September 14 episode in Mexico City, notably with Vice securing her spot during an impressive main roster debut. WWE Money in the Bank 2026 is scheduled for Saturday, October 10, live from the Smoothie King Center in New Orleans, Louisiana.

stories.title: Good Brothers reveal WWE offered no pay cut option prior to departure
stories.tldr: Doc Gallows and Karl Anderson recently discussed their latest WWE departure on their Talk’n Shop podcast, revealing they were never given the option to take a pay cut to stay with the company. While other veterans like Sheamus were reportedly given reduced salary alternatives, The Good Brothers were simply released without a choice. Although they initially debated whether they would have accepted less money, both admitted they ultimately would have taken the pay cut to remain with WWE. Following their exit, the duo has since returned to active competition in Japan with promotions like Pro Wrestling NOAH and New Japan Pro-Wrestling, alongside appearances in MLW and Maple Leaf Pro.

stories.title: AJ Lee reveals she hid her bipolar diagnosis during her WWE career
stories.tldr: Former WWE star AJ Lee recently revealed on the Mind Over Mountain podcast that she hid her bipolar diagnosis throughout her entire wrestling career, having been diagnosed around the age of 19 before signing with the company. During her time on the road, she dealt with intense emotional struggles in private, often crying in bathroom stalls or sitting alone in cars while her peers went to the gym, largely out of fear and shame due to the cultural climate of the era. Although she kept her condition secret while achieving immense success in the ring, she eventually shared her story in her memoir and has since become a prominent mental health advocate after stepping away from television and finding proper treatment.

stories.title: Roxanne Perez reflects on her WWE career growth beyond being 'just a prodigy'
stories.tldr: Roxanne Perez is reflecting on her evolution in WWE, moving away from her initial label as just a young prodigy to embracing her status as a legitimate main roster star. Having debuted with a pre-established reputation at a very young age, the 24-year-old has since built an impressive resume that includes multiple championships across NXT and the main roster. In a recent interview, she expressed confidence that both she and the fans now view her as a master of her craft rather than just a promising up-and-comer.

stories.title: Bayley sends warning to Lyra Valkyria on WWE RAW
stories.tldr: Bayley issued a direct backstage warning to Lyra Valkyria during the September 14, 2026 episode of WWE RAW, making it clear that her recent attack was only the beginning of a deeply personal feud. This follows Bayley's surprise return on the September 7 episode, where she cost Valkyria her Money in the Bank qualifying match against Maxxine Dupri by pulling the referee out of the ring and later attempting to put Valkyria through a table. Bayley stated that she is done letting anyone use her emotions against her and promised to remind everyone why she is the standard of women's wrestling.

stories.title: Natalya asked to extend WWE NXT stay to work alongside Jaida Parker
stories.tldr: Veteran WWE star Natalya revealed that she personally requested to extend her recent run in NXT specifically to work with rising talent Jaida Parker, whom she compares to the female Jacob Fatu. Natalya approached booker Shawn Michaels with the idea after seeing immense potential in Parker and wanting to test her character against the newcomer's unique edge. Their resulting feud spanned multiple matches, including a rubber match at NXT Heatwave where Parker used Natalya's own submission hold to win. Natalya believes this program pushed Parker to deliver the best work of her career so far.

stories.title: Liv Morgan featured in trailer for Japanese movie release
stories.tldr: WWE star Liv Morgan makes an appearance in the newly released official Japanese trailer for the upcoming film Bad Lieutenant: Tokyo. Directed by Takashi Miike, the movie is premiering at the Toronto International Film Festival ahead of a planned theatrical release. This project is just one of several acting endeavors for Morgan outside of the wrestling ring, as she has also cast in the psychological thriller Ping.

stories.title: Analysis of Pete Dunne's role as a WWE producer
stories.tldr: Although fans may know him best as Pete Dunne, the star currently wrestles as Rayo Americano alongside Tyler Bate as part of Los Americanos in AAA and WWE Raw. Beyond his on-screen work, Dunne has quietly built a successful backstage career as a WWE producer, drawing on a sharp wrestling mind that was recognized long before he signed with the company. Having started producing back in 2020 during COVID-19 travel restrictions, Dunne continues to balance his in-ring persona with valuable behind-the-scenes contributions.

stories.title: Speculation surrounding internal conflict within WWE's Bloodline
stories.tldr: The Bloodline is facing significant internal and external pressure from Royce Keys’ 946 faction as well as the team of LA Knight and Solo Sikoa. This mounting stress threatens to fracture Roman Reigns and his family, with Jacob Fatu emerging as the most likely member to break away. A potential three-way WarGames match at Survivor Series could serve as the ultimate breaking point for these colliding storylines.

stories.title: Brad Williams reflects on his Danhausen 'Minihausen' WWE SummerSlam appearance
stories.tldr: Comedian Brad Williams recently shared how he was unexpectedly cast as one of Danhausen's Minihausens for a comedic match at WWE SummerSlam where Danhausen defeated Dominik Mysterio. After receiving a sudden phone call on Thursday for the Saturday event, Williams quickly accepted and flew to Minneapolis the next day with the blessing of his patient wife. During the flight, he amused and likely creeped out fellow passengers by practicing Danhausen's distinct voice to prepare for the role. Despite wearing full face paint, Williams was still recognized by a few fans and ultimately called the entire behind-the-scenes WWE experience unforgettable.

stories.title: Google Search interest for WWE RAW drops compared to prior year
stories.tldr: Google Search interest for WWE RAW has declined significantly, showing a twenty percent drop over the recent three month period and a thirty percent decrease compared to last year. While the product saw temporary spikes following events like Night of Champions, the absence of major stars like Cody Rhodes, CM Punk, and Sami Zayn on the brand has left Monday nights struggling for momentum. Analysts note that this downward trend, combined with a dip in specific searches for raw results, could impact marketing metrics despite RAW remaining a dominant wrestling powerhouse.

stories.title: Roxanne Perez addresses criticism regarding her current WWE entrance theme
stories.tldr: Roxanne Perez recently addressed the mixed fan reaction to her updated WWE entrance theme, explaining that music changes are always a difficult transition for audiences. She believes the new remix better reflects her evolved character's confident and assertive persona as the WWE prodigy. Additionally, Perez shared her perspective on competing in the Royal Rumble, noting that the constant in-ring action makes the lengthy match feel like it goes by in just ten minutes.

stories.title: Rikishi explains how 'The Stinkface' move originated in WWE
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Rikishi recently discussed the origins of his infamous signature maneuver, the Stinkface. During an interview, he explained that the comedic move was born out of a simple desire to further entertain the fans using his unique ring attire. He realized that since his backside was exposed, he might as well use it to give the audience something to smile about. Furthermore, he emphasized that the move was strictly about sports entertainment and was never meant to be personal toward his opponents.

stories.title: Rey Mysterio reveals unusual souvenir kept from 2010 WWE feud with CM Punk
stories.tldr: Rey Mysterio recently reflected on his memorable 2010 WWE feud with CM Punk, highlighting their deep history that dates back to the independent scene before Mysterio returned to the company in 2002. During the interview, Mysterio praised Punk's incredible in-ring development and overall talent. The WWE Hall of Famer then made the surprising revelation that he kept a literal piece of Punk's hair after defeating him at Over the Limit in 2010. Following traditional lucha libre customs, Mysterio stored the hair in a dated Ziploc bag and keeps it in a photo album with other career memorabilia.

stories.title: Roman Reigns defeats Penta to retain World Heavyweight Championship on WWE RAW in Mexico
stories.tldr: Roman Reigns successfully defended his World Heavyweight Championship against Penta in front of a heavily hostile, pro-Penta crowd in Mexico City on Monday Night Raw. Despite Penta coming close to an upset with multiple near-falls and targeting the champion's arm, Reigns ultimately secured the win with a mid-air Superman Punch and a Spear. Following the hard-fought match, an emotional Penta addressed the arena, expressing pride in his performance and demanding a future rematch to fulfill his promise of becoming world champion.

stories.title: El Grande Americano returns to WWE RAW following AAA Mega Title victory
stories.tldr: Fresh off capturing the AAA Mega Championship, El Grande Americano made his explosive return to WWE RAW in Mexico City to a massive ovation. He immediately teamed up with Stephanie Vaquer in a mixed tag team match against Dominik Mysterio and Liv Morgan. However, the celebration was cut short when The Judgment Day interfered, leading to a chaotic post-match beatdown.

stories.title: Rey Mysterio discusses WWE retirement plans and desire for another world title run
stories.tldr: Rey Mysterio has shared new details regarding his eventual retirement, revealing a personal dream to share the ring with both his son Dominik and his newly-training daughter Aalyah in a historic family angle. The Hall of Famer also named Dominik as his original choice to eventually retire him in a future rematch. Additionally, Mysterio expressed strong interest in pursuing another world championship run before hanging up his boots.

stories.title: Roman Reigns wears custom lucha mask on WWE RAW in Mexico City
stories.tldr: Roman Reigns debuted a custom lucha-style mask during his entrance at WWE Raw in Mexico City. He successfully defended his World Heavyweight Championship against Penta following a hard-fought main event featuring numerous near falls. The historic broadcast marked the first time Raw emanated from Mexico City in 15 years.

stories.title: Sami Zayn's Undisputed WWE Title win and backstage reaction
stories.tldr: Following Sami Zayn's shocking Undisputed WWE Championship victory on SmackDown, new backstage details have emerged regarding the creative direction and internal reactions to the title change. WWE reportedly booked the surprise switch to set up a champion versus champion match against Roman Reigns at Crown Jewel, while avoiding a rematch between Punk and Reigns. Meanwhile, Netflix censored an unscripted, vulgar line from Punk's pre-match promo, and sources note that some backstage officials initially opposed the title switch.

stories.title: Roxanne Perez set to defend title at WWE Worlds Collide
stories.tldr: Roxanne Perez is officially stepping up to challenge newly crowned AAA Reina de Reinas Champion La Catalina at WWE Worlds Collide. Perez earned the title opportunity by defeating Nattie, La Hiedra, and Faby Apache in a four-way match on the first night of TripleMania 34.
